1.Name: Judgment Blade - Reaper Scythe
1.Description: Close-range weapon, the sickle longsword focuses on a single slash, instantly cutting down the enemy, while the scythe pursues multiple consecutive strikes, wielding blade light, alternating use, showcasing unique combat skills.

2.Name: Frostjade Staff - Magic Wand
2.Description: Mid-to-long-range weapon, using water elements as a medium, combining the power of ice and flowing water, freezing everything under extreme cold and causing massive damage.

3.Name: Scourgefire Axe - Battle Axe
3.Description: Close-range weapon, giving the warrior an indomitable fighting spirit, with an Ultimate that can enter an enhanced state, bursting out incredible energy in a short time, destroying everything in its path, and exuding a formidable aura.

4.Name: Justice Lance - Lance
4.Description: Close-range weapon, the spear strikes like a dragon, accumulating battle intent with each attack, forming an indestructible shield around the warrior for solid defense. As the power reaches its peak, the warrior can throw the spear farther, releasing a devastating strike like a meteor streaking across the night sky.

5.Name: Fatewood Ring - Magic Ring
5.Description: Mid-range weapon, controlling the power of nature, adept at using vines and flower seeds to attack enemies, possessing considerable healing abilities, like a guardian of nature, capable of both destroying enemies and protecting allies.

8.Name: Thunder Flash - Hand Cannon
8.Description: Long-range weapon, powerful output hand, with a large skill range and continuous on-site output, extremely adept at handling multiple enemies. With the fury of thunder, it clears obstacles ahead with great momentum.

9.Name: Sandward - Blade
9.Description: A close-range weapon, a defensive expert with considerable damage. The sword's momentum is overwhelming and unstoppable. Its broad blade not only provides a rock-solid sense of stability but also gathers the power of rock and sand to unleash astonishing destructive force.

10.Name: (Temporary) Rorola
10.Description: (Temporary) This is a description and story of a scythe-shaped long blade, no text.

11.Name: Bow
11.Description: A long-range weapon, a powerful damage dealer with a wide skill range and continuous on-field output, excelling at dealing with multiple enemies. Strikes everything in sight with the fury of thunder.

12.Name: Frostjade Staff - Magic Wand
12.Description: Mid-to-long-range weapon, using water elements as a medium, combining the power of ice and flowing water, freezing everything under extreme cold and causing massive damage.

201.Name: EXP
201.Description:
Completing activity goals, commissions, and quests can earn experience. When the experience reaches a certain level, the Adventurer Level can be increased.
Increasing the Adventurer Level not only provides attribute boosts, Bio-Engram gifts, and Talent Points.

202.Name: EXP (blessing)
202.Description:

Increasing the Adventurer Level not only provides attribute boosts, Bio-Engram gifts, and Talent Points.

203.Name: S2 EXP
203.Description:
You can gain EXP by completing daily activity goals, commissions, and quests. Earn enough EXP to reach a higher Adventurer Level.
Increasing your Adventurer Level grants stat boosts, Bio-Engram gifts, and Talent Points.

301.Name: Season Pass EXP
301.Description:
Earned by completing activity goals. When Season Pass EXP reaches a certain level, the Season Pass level can be increased.
Increasing the Season Pass level allows you to claim generous rewards.

302.Name: Season Pass EXP (Not counted toward weekly limit)
302.Description:
Earned by completing daily activity goals. Once enough EXP is accumulated, your Season Pass level increases.
Higher Season Pass levels grant generous rewards.
Season Pass EXP earned does not count toward the weekly limit.

402.Name: Dreambloom Season EXP
402.Description: You can gain season EXP by completing daily activity goals, commissions, and quests. Earn enough EXP to reach a higher season level.

403.Name: Echoes of Ember Season EXP
403.Description:
You can gain EXP by completing daily activity goals, commissions, and quests. Earn enough EXP to reach a higher season level.
Increasing your season level not only grants stat boosts and special item rewards but also unlocks additional gameplay features of the season.

404.Name: Season EXP (Season 4)
404.Description:
You can gain EXP by completing daily activity goals, commissions, and quests. Earn enough EXP to reach a higher season level.
Increasing your season level not only grants stat boosts and special item rewards but also unlocks additional gameplay features of the season.

405.Description:

10001.Name: Season 1 Points
10001.Description:
A large amount of season points can be obtained through season titles, Achievements, and Season Pass rewards. Completing the mission goals for the season can earn a small amount of season points.
Once obtained, they can be exchanged in the Season Store for items that enhance strength, crafting materials, and more.
10001.Description2: <color=#e67373>An exclusive season item of Void Corruption Frenzy, now expired.</color>

10002.Name: Luno
10002.Description: Acquired through operating Trading Center and mainly used for circulation in the Trading Center.
10002.Description2: A currency made from rare metals, recognized by adventurers across the Continent of Magna for its value.

10003.Name: Rose Orb
10003.Description: Commonly used to purchase appearances and other items in the Store, and can also be consigned in the trading center to obtain Luno.
10003.Description2: A rare currency made from precious gems, primarily known for its eye-catching and luxurious appearance.

10004.Name: Friendship Points
10004.Description: Use to exchange for exclusive appearance blueprints, dyes, emotes, and other content in the Friendship Points Store.
10004.Description2: Your long adventure won't be a lonely one. Along the way, like-minded companions will stand by you in critical moments—and you'll be an indispensable ally to them too. Forward together, adventurers!

10005.Name: Rose Orb (Bound)
10005.Description: Commonly used to purchase appearances and other items in the Store.
10005.Description2: A rare currency made from precious gems, primarily known for its eye-catching and luxurious appearance.

10006.Name: Honor Coin
10006.Description: Completing activity goals, weekly gameplay, and missions can almost always earn Honor Coins, but there is a weekly limit. Use to exchange for strength-enhancing items in the Honor Coins Store, it is a basic yet important token during the growth process!
10006.Description2: Words like "Fight for the glory of the Pioneer Bureau!" keep echoing in my ears. Valeria must have drilled them into me far too often.

10007.Name: Supply Points
10007.Description: Energy-infused gems, commonly used to exchange for items in the Store.

10008.Name: Luno (Bound)
10008.Description: Bound Luno cannot be traded in the trading center. However it is still indispensable for growth and adventure, and can be obtained through daily adventure activities.
10008.Description2: Currency made of rare metals, recognized by adventurers on the Magna Road.

10009.Name: Meow Coin
10009.Description: Can be exchanged for limited edition appearance rewards in the Meow Member Store.
10009.Description2: A precious metal badge specially customized by the well-known Asterleeds Meowlux Merchant Guild, regularly given to chamber members. With the badge, members can exchange for some limited edition appearance rewards that are not sold to the public, as a sincere thank you from the chamber for their long-term support. This badge is affectionately called "Meow Coin" by the members.

10010.Name: Homestead Coin
10010.Description: A special currency used within the Homestead System, allowing you to purchase various homestead-related items from the Homestead Store. It can also be used for Cleanup to restore Homestead Cleanliness.

10011.Name: Reclaim Token
10011.Description:
Missed certain challenges or rewards? You can reclaim them in the Reclaim Hub using Reclaim Tokens.
The Reclaim Hub will stock items based on the rewards you've won from various activities. If you don't have enough points to redeem all of the week's compensatory rewards, you'll earn bonus Reclaim Tokens proportionally when earning Honor Coins through activities.
The weekly limit resets every Monday at 05:00(UTC-2).
Weekly Limit: {*val1*}/{*val2*}

10013.Name: Rose Orb
10013.Description: Commonly used to purchase appearances and other items in the Store, and can also be consigned in the trading center to obtain Luno.
10013.Description2: A rare currency made from precious gems, primarily known for its eye-catching and luxurious appearance.

10014.Name: Dreambloom Season Points
10014.Description:
You can earn a large amount of season points through season Title, Achievement, and Season Pass rewards. Completing daily activity goals grants a small amount of season points.
Season points can be exchanged in the Season Store for power-boosting items and crafting materials.
10014.Description2: <color=#e67373>An exclusive item for the Dreambloom season, now expired.</color>

10015.Name: Starland Medal
10015.Description: A token issued by the Meowlux Merchant Guild, valid only on Starland.

10016.Name: Echoes of Ember Season Points
10016.Description:
A large amount of season points can be obtained through season titles, Achievements, and Season Pass rewards. Completing the mission goals for the season can earn a small amount of season points.
Once obtained, they can be exchanged in the Season Store for items that enhance strength, crafting materials, and more.

10017.Name: Echoes of Ember Resonance Sigil
10017.Description:
Points obtained from Chaotic Realm, Stimen Vaults, Boss Loot Chests, or by participating in Starland events.
A maximum of 200 of this item can be held at once.
Once obtained, they can be exchanged for rare materials in the Elite Season Store.
10017.Description2: An imprint left behind by the resonance of a world in perpetual rotation.

11002.Name: Adept's Badge
11002.Description: A medal earned through the Adept's Trial can be exchanged for exclusive gear at the Seabreeze Festival Store.

11003.Name: Ancestral Spore
11003.Description: A spore treasured by the Kanamians. Can be traded for gifts at the Harvest Festival Store.
11003.Description2:
As the festival commences, the priests scatter spore-laden spices throughout the land.
The Kanamians, after singing and dancing to the point of exhaustion, simply lean against whatever is near or find a quiet place, slipping into dreams.
The spores take effect quietly, drifting through each slumbering mind, weaving the dreams of the Kanamians together.
In these dreams, they meet their ancestors, whisper to all living things, and resonate with another self.

11004.Name: Seed of Floating Dreams
11004.Description: Obtainable by trading Dim Dreamstones at the safe zone within the Land of Crimson Illusion.

11005.Name: Shining Seed of Floating Dreams
11005.Description: Obtainable from Week 2 of the event by trading Dim Dreamstones at the safe zone within the Land of Crimson Illusion.

11006.Name: Event Currency Placeholder
11006.Description2: A special currency exclusive to the Whimsical Winterfest, engraved with patterns of an ancient snow cedar.

11007.Name: Nappo's Snowball
11007.Description:
Obtained by participating in Snowman Strike! Nappo Hunt during the Winterfest event. It can be exchanged in the Winterfest Store Store for the Chilling Nappo - Headwear.
You can earn up to 100 of these by participating in Snow Nappo activities.
11007.Description2: A snowball ornament painted with Nappo's portrait. It seems exchangeable for exclusive accessories.

11008.Name: Mahjong Event Points
11008.Description: Participate in the themed event "Bird's Luck - Flowering on the Ridge" until the final settlement of each game to earn points based on final ranking and score. Reaching specific point milestones grants rewards such as Full Slam series accessories, avatar frames, namecards, badges, and more.
11008.Description2: The event point cap opens in stages and resets every Monday at 05:00 (UTC-2) (maximum stage cap is 20,000 points).

11009.Name: Renewal Seal
11009.Description:
Obtained by participating in the Renewal Festival event. Can be exchanged at the Renewal Store for bound festival rewards, including limited appearance items, Namecards, and Badges. Can also be traded for Renewal Light Wish Coins, Rose Orbs, and large amounts of Luno.
This item will expire after 05:00 on Mar. 12, 2026.
11009.Description2: Every action taken during the Renewal Festival, no matter how small, is recorded by the Radiance of Seasons and turned into a unique mark.

12001.Name: Shangri-La Frontier - Gold Meow Point
12001.Description: An exclusive lottery item for the "Shangri-La Frontier" Meowlux Special prize pool. Can be obtained through the "Starry Carnival" event. If insufficient when drawing, a quick purchase window will appear. After the crossover ends, this item will become invalid and can be returned to Meownia at Cat's Eye Emporium in Starland for recycling into Starland Medals.

13008.Name: Astral Encounter Wishbox
13008.Description: Open to obtain one Fairy Tail - Wish Coin (Bound) and a random toy.

13009.Name: Adventure Bond Proof
13009.Description:
Obtained by participating in the Fairy Tail crossover event. Accumulate a certain amount to claim generous rewards from the "Guild Request Board" in the "Starry Carnival" event.

Rewards include: Fairy Tail - Wish Coin (Bound), Fairy Tail - Imagine Morph - Select, crossover buff item - Dragon Slayer Power, Imagine Material - Select, Excellent Enhanced Module Select Chest - Premium, Excellent Module - Select, Refinement Materials - Select, and Astral Gold Meow Ticket III.
13009.Description2: Marks left quietly by fighting side by side—recording the reasons for encounters, trust, and setting off again.

20001.Name: Energy Points
20001.Description: Energy Points that can be converted into other items.

20002.Description: Obtained by completing different Monster Hunt targets, it can increase the Monster Hunt level. Each level increase rewards items, and reaching specific levels grants special rewards!

20003.Name: Focus
20003.Description:

20006.Name: Emblem Power Parts
20006.Description:
To commend adventurers with outstanding performance in the current season, Pioneer Bureau gifts Power Parts upon their title promotion. These can be activated to Emblem Cores to enhance their effects.

20012.Name: Newbie Credits
20012.Description: Credits earned through Newbie Special Operation. Little Sprout, enjoy your adventure!

1022201.Name: Reforge Stone Lv.40
1022201.Description:
Used to reforge Lv.40 gear to improve Gear Perfection.
Dismantling Reforged gear will return all previously consumed Reforge Stones. Tradable in the Trading Center during the Void Corruption Frenzy season.
1022201.Description2:
Since its inception, this material has been highly regarded for its high substitutability. Some craftsmen believe that the heritage purifies the primal substances in the material, playing a restorative role. Others believe that the heritage destroys all material properties, playing a composite role.
But at least one thing can be agreed upon-the intermediate process of heritage Forging will remain a mystery.

1022303.Description:
An energy Engram Core extracted from Weaver products. It can be exchanged for Weaver series replica gear from Special Agent Cassie at the Artisan Guild.
Replica gear has the same effects as the set, and it can be mixed and matched to activate set bonuses. Dismantling it yields Superconducting Alloy Shards.
1022303.Description2:
Since its inception, this material has been highly regarded for its high substitutability. Some craftsmen believe that the legacy purifies the primal substances in the material, playing a restorative role. Others believe that the legacy neutralizes all material properties, playing a composite role.
But at least one thing can be agreed upon—the intermediate process of legacy smelting will remain a mystery.

1022304.Name: Illusion Crystal
1022304.Description:
Crystalshards infused with mysterious energy. Visit Cassie, the Artisan Guild's Floating Island emissary, for the [Illusion] set's breakthrough and level-up. Each breakthrough costs 20 Crystals and increases gear level by 10, up to a maximum of 250.
If the breakthrough-enhanced gear is dismantled, all Illusion Crystals previously used will be fully refunded.

1030001.Name: Anchor Notes
1030001.Description2: A notebook held by every member of Asterleeds Defense Corps, used to record investigated clues. "Don't miss any corner, find the anchor point of the truth."

1030002.Name: Sea Lily
1030002.Description2:
The pure Sea Lily is a symbol of the Seabreeze Festival-in Asterleeds, people often use this flower to express thoughts and blessings.
Whether printed on sweet or melancholic letters, or placed on windowsills where people long for each other: where there are emotions, there are Sea Lilies.

1030003.Name: Medal of Light
1030003.Description2:
To commemorate the victory of the Asterleeds Independence War, a special Seabreeze Festival medal issued by Asterleeds.
"People should remember the nightmare of yesterday. It was those flames and burning tears that brought the sun to today."

1030004.Name: Someone's Old Necklace
1030004.Description2: A precious item carrying fragments of the past. At that time, the future story had not yet happened. And both of them thought they would always walk side by side like this, heading towards every brilliant tomorrow.

1030005.Name: Note from Tina
1030005.Description2: "My friend, do you remember the 'drink' I mentioned? I still can't forget its taste. When we meet again, let's have another one. It's the true choice of a tough guy. Tough-guy, you understand? Its color is as powerful as flames. The moment I drank it, I felt my heart and soul become fiery..."

1030006.Name: Red Berry Serum
1030006.Description2: A Serum mixed with flavors of pomegranate, cherry, currant, raspberry, etc., used to mix drinks in the storyline gameplay.

1030007.Name: Blue Citrus Serum
1030007.Description2: A deep blue Serum containing the color of the ocean, exuding the breath of seabreeze, used to mix drinks in the storyline gameplay.

1030008.Name: Soda
1030008.Description2: A classic ingredient in Asterleeds drinks, with every bubble reflecting the memories of the city, used to mix drinks in the storyline gameplay.

1030009.Name: Lemonade
1030009.Description2: A classic ingredient in Asterleeds drinks, sour, selfless, and addictive, used to mix drinks in the storyline gameplay.

1030010.Name: Chilled Drink
1030010.Description2: A method for making Chilled Drink! Use to mix drinks in the storyline gameplay.

1030011.Name: Hot Drink
1030011.Description2: A method for making Hot Drink! Use to mix drinks in the storyline gameplay.

1030012.Name: Medal Shard
1030012.Description2: Fragments of Tina's honor medal after it broke. The Void Engram has not yet cleared, and its secrets need further clarification.

1030013.Name: File (Sealed)
1030013.Description2: The File stolen by Tatta, still unopened.

1030014.Name: File (Opened)
1030014.Description2: The File stolen by Tatta, now opened. It contains a lot of information about Jayden and the Dark Mist Legion, specific details need to be read from the original document.

1030015.Name: Jayden's Letter
1030015.Description2: A letter from Jayden to Tatta, detailing some information about Denvel and Jayden's thoughts about Tatta, specific details need to be read from the original document.

1030016.Name: Invitation from the Designer Guild
1030016.Description2: (This is a short letter written on paper with a pearl-like smooth texture. When held up to the sunlight, the watermark on the paper shimmers with a beautiful luster. The handwriting is in pearlescent ink, sealed with a ribbon, and emits a faint floral and woody fragrance.)

1030017.Name: Invitation from the Bluewave Anglers
1030017.Description2: (This is a letter written on a page torn from a sturdy and rough notebook, with rough tear marks still visible on the edges. The handwriting is somewhat difficult to decipher, and the letter emits a faint fishy smell.)

1030018.Name: Invitation from the Artisan Guild
1030018.Description2: (This is a letter written on the back of drawing paper, with weapon design sketches and data drafts visible on the other side of the paper.)

1030019.Name: Invitation from the Culinary Guild
1030019.Description2: (This is a fragrant letter—not an elegant aroma but an enticing smell of delicious food. The letter paper smells like butter cake.)

1030023.Name: Surprise Card (Ee-chan)
1030023.Description2: A card with Ee-chan printed on the front.

1030024.Name: Surprise Card (Blank)
1030024.Description2: A blank card with nothing on it.

1030025.Name: Ocean Platinum Card
1030025.Description2: An identification issued by the council to honor citizens of Asterleeds, aimed at recognizing the outstanding contributions of the Platinum Card holder to Asterleeds.

1030026.Name: Party Invitation
1030026.Description2: Boarding pass for the cruise party.

1030030.Name: Hand-Drawn Treasure Map (I)
1030030.Description2: A crumpled, dark yellow oil paper treasure map, with a simple sketch outlining the Asteria Plains...

1030031.Name: Hand-Drawn Treasure Map (II)
1030031.Description2: A crumpled, mud-stained oil paper treasure map, with a simple sketch depicting a few connected "golden waves"...

1030032.Name: Shadow of the Past - devote to Hills
1030032.Description2: An ordinary sheet of letter paper, pressed very flat by the notebook. It reveals smudges of ink spreading between the lines.

1030035.Name: Setting Reading Material
1030035.Description2: (Temporary) Main storyline phase five obtained setting reading material.

1030036.Name: Aged Purple Bellflower
1030036.Description: A rare purple plant growing in special areas, emitting a strange fragrance. Inhaling too much may cause fainting.

1030037.Name: Void Arachnocrab's Sac
1030037.Description: The sac of the Void Arachnocrab that stores nutrients, and the secretions inside are very rare fixative raw materials.

1030040.Name: Note with a Badge
1030040.Description2: Maintaining a daily journaling habit is hard-really hard. But... thank goodness this person managed to stick with it!

1030041.Name: Shift Schedule
1030041.Description2:
A shift log of the Blackstone Legion at the open-pit mine.
People may lie, but forms do not. Even if it has been sugarcoated, the act of covering up already reveals the truth.

1030042.Name: Sid's Hand-Drawn Map
1030042.Description2: Sid transcribed the records from the ancient book, and the stark contrast between the recorder's rough handwriting and Sid's beautifully annotated notes was striking.

1030043.Name: Cobalt Sea Lily
1030043.Description2: The entirely Cobalt Sea Lily, apart from its color, seems no different from an ordinary Sea Lily, but upon closer inspection, its leaves and roots are more slender and elongated.

1030044.Name: Water Sample of Pale Azure Lake
1030044.Description2: A water sample collected from Pale Azure Lake, clear and transparent, with no visible impurities.

1030045.Name: Fireworks from Airona
1030045.Description:
After using the item, the Basic Attack button is replaced with a fireworks button.
Tap the button to randomly release a sparkler or place fireworks at the location.

1030047.Name: Ceremonial Staff
1030047.Description2: Ceremonial Staff of the Kanamia Priest.

1030048.Name: Forbidden Key
1030048.Description2: One of the three keys to open the Forbidden Zone of Kanamia.

1030049.Name: Old Envelope
1030049.Description2: An old letter containing a thin sheet of letter paper and a scent pouch whose fragrance has long faded.

1030053.Name: Supply Crate from Olvera
1030053.Description: Contains: Luno (Bound) x51222, Healing Aromatic Lv.2 x5

1030054.Name: Supply Crate from Tina
1030054.Description: Contains: Luno (Bound) x50314, Healing Aromatic Lv.2 x5

1030055.Name: Olvera's Blessing
1030055.Description: Grants Olvera's Blessing upon use: +20% ATK for 60s. Cannot be used in Master 17 or higher in Chaotic Space.

1030056.Name: Tina's Blessing
1030056.Description: Grants Tina's Blessing upon use: +20% DMG Reduction for 60s. Cannot be used in Master 17 or higher in Chaotic Space.

1030057.Name: Precious Sea Lily
1030057.Description2: A protective charm handcrafted by Olvera. Inside a clear glass bottle, soft white and ocean-blue petals shimmer like starlight, as if sealing the seabreeze and blessings of Asterleeds within. May this guardian from your homeland guide you across every mountain and sea.

1030058.Name: Seabreeze Compass
1030058.Description2: A cherished item of Tina's that accompanied her through a childhood of wandering. Though worn from time, the compass remains accurate. It is said to guide the lost back home-may it protect you during the journey as well.

1030060.Name: A metal pendant
1030060.Description2: A rusted pendant. On the front, faint words can just be made out: Vein Riveting. On the back, four more words are etched: Sin Valve ■ Open.

1030061.Name: A pair of glasses
1030061.Description2: A pair of broken glasses, smeared with grime and green mold. The once-elegant frames are tarnished. The lens is shattered, and the right temple bears a tiny engraving: Webber Industry.

1030062.Name: A compass
1030062.Description2: A finely crafted compass, apparently having suffered some tremendous impact-its enamel casing shattered, its delicate inner workings gutted, and the intricate designs that once adorned its surface were all but erased by wear. In the right flank, a faint inscription remains etched in the metal: Energy Network's Property - "Ember" Batch - 217.

1030065.Name: Rusty Key
1030065.Description2: Every key matches a lock. This one is no exception.

1030066.Name: Journal of an unknown owner
1030066.Description2: Maintaining a daily journaling habit is hard-really hard. But... thank goodness this person managed to stick with it!

1030067.Name: Crimson Marrow Shard
1030067.Description2: Nappo's grand adventure has come to an end. This is the reward from the final stop.

1030068.Name: Airona's Letter
1030068.Description2: A letter written in elegant handwriting. The letter was penned on soft, off-white paper imbued with a delicate floral fragrance. Its author, a green-haired girl, had written it in quiet anticipation of a long-awaited reunion.

1030069.Name: Narulu's Diary
1030069.Description2: Narulu's personal diary chronicles a pivotal chapter of his life-from the restless stirrings of youth to the resolute decision to embrace the path of an adventurer. Each page echoes with trials endured and the steady forging of his will.

1030070.Name: A whole box (?) Note
1030070.Description2: It's hard to imagine how many stories could be carried in a whole box of notes.

1030071.Name: A marked map
1030071.Description2: The bright red markings stand out sharply. A desperate person's last trump card is hidden here.

1030072.Name: A faded medal
1030072.Description2: It once symbolized honor, but now its ribbon has lost its color, and the paint on the medal has peeled and dulled.

1030073.Name: A bag of wheat cakes
1030073.Description2: Wheat cakes handmade by Anemone. As an apology gift, it isn't expensive, but it's sincere.

1030081.Name: Longsight scope
1030081.Description2: The casing of the longsight scope gleams brightly. No wonder birds are attracted to it.

1030083.Name: Unpolished stone
1030083.Description2: This raw stone doesn't look special on the outside, but Aylen believes it will shine brilliantly once polished.

1030084.Name: Gleaming gemstone
1030084.Description2: The plain stone from Aylen was shaped by Elarik and now radiates dazzling brilliance. If a gemstone could purchase love, it deserves the most passionate and beautiful love in the world.

1030085.Name: Express package
1030085.Description2: An express package from the Duchy of Byrnhald, signed by the sender Shaene. Who knows what the goblins did to this package... In any case, it is not very well sealed now.

1030086.Name: Belated Ring of Vows
1030086.Description2: It does not belong to any love story. It is merely proof that a certain mail carrier performed their duty faithfully. Even if the ending is not perfect, the token must still be delivered.

1030087.Name: Sid's Request
1030087.Description2: One of the two letters Sid sent to you. The handwriting is neat and elegant as always.

1030088.Name: Letter to Evelyn
1030088.Description2: A letter Sid wrote to Evelyn. From the handwriting, you can tell Sid was not as calm as usual when writing it. He seemed nervous and serious.

1030089.Name: Rockthistle Seed
1030089.Description2: Tiny brown seeds brimming with vigorous life. Even atop steep cliffs, they can take root and bloom pale yellow flowers.

1030090.Name: Transport Station Special Business Permit
1030090.Description2: In short, with this permit, you're allowed to conduct business at the Bekmar Transport Station. But what's the price?

1030091.Name: Nameplate
1030091.Description2: A nameplate of the Blackstone Legion, engraved with the name Carl.

1030092.Name: Damaged merchant's journal
1030092.Description2: It looks like a merchant's journal. Many lines have been soaked in dark stains and are hard to read.

1030093.Name: Secret letter
1030093.Description2: A secret letter revealing a merchant's intent to commit treason.

1030094.Name: Large rock
1030094.Description2: A large chunk of black stone with jagged edges and metallic sheen, looking very hard.

1030095.Name: Medium-sized rock
1030095.Description2: A medium-sized, deep-green crystal with a glassy shine is embedded firmly in a brown-yellow base. The two are fused so tightly they cannot be separated.

1030096.Name: Small rock
1030096.Description2: A small, round-edged stone with a fragile texture and faint hueful patterns.

1030097.Name: Romance of Steel and Silk
1030097.Description2: The new picture book Rowan asked you to deliver to Darcy.

1030098.Name: Scrawled manuscript
1030098.Description2: The handwriting is messy. Even so, you can tell it's only an outline of a story. If you could find the owner of the manuscript, perhaps it would become a complete tale.

1030099.Name: Stored Soothing Honeydew
1030099.Description2: A long-stored bottle of Soothing Honeydew. Its fragrance has almost faded, yet it still offers decent healing effects.

1030100.Name: Healing Herb
1030100.Description2: A commonly used herb for stopping bleeding.

1030101.Name: Dane's Letter
1030101.Description2: A letter written by Dane to the Scholar Camp while trapped in the maze. Perhaps he hoped his companions would not worry.

1030106.Name: "Dragon's Temptation" (Author Signed Edition)
1030106.Description2:
"Every beat of my pulse is proof of your existence."
The latest controversial work by a renowned author from the continent!
A love waltz co-written by humans and dragons!

To my dear friend,
Have a pleasant journey.
—Isabella

1052001.Name: Dragon Feather Silk
1052001.Description: Although there is no conclusive evidence that it is indeed refined from the scales on the wings of wild dragons, it is certain that any product incorporating this material appears extremely luxurious, thus highly favored by the nobility.

1052002.Name: Magunia Crystal
1052002.Description2: Harvested from the ancient Magunia tree on the Continent of Magna, it is a rare and mysterious material, hence very valuable. It is easy to process and mix with other materials, combining various properties, which is its main appeal.

1052100.Name: Source Energy - Rare
1052100.Description: An Exquisite Material, mainly used for crafting Ultimate-type Battle Imagines.
1052100.Description2: A wondrous orb of energy, believed to awaken the latent potential slumbering within.

1052101.Name: Brand of Chaos - Rare
1052101.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Boss monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Arcane!" Battle Imagine.
1052101.Description2: A strange mark, the pattern seems to have life. Rather than saying the pattern of the mark is sloppy, it is more like some kind of unfinished evolution, with potential that has not been fully released.

1052102.Name: Amber of Time - Rare
1052102.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Boss monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Arcane!" Battle Imagine.
1052102.Description2: A strange amber stone that evokes a sense of familiarity in anyone, yet they forget when it appeared, hastily picking it up and carrying it closely, hoping to one day recover the lost memory.

1052103.Name: Prism of Illusion - Rare
1052103.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Boss monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Arcane!" Battle Imagine.
1052103.Description2: A peculiar thread, interwoven with colors, as if the rainbow after the rain has been shattered and re-woven. Even the most skilled weaver cannot replicate its brilliance. It seems to have slipped through a gap in some illusion, quietly arriving with the lingering warmth of thoughts.

1052104.Name: Shreds of Reality - Rare
1052104.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Boss monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Arcane!" Battle Imagine.
1052104.Description2: A peculiar wisp of ash, formed from the supercritical state of an object that has endured destruction beyond its limits. When touched, it gives a sense of falling into an abyss, as if some remnants of disaster still linger.

1052105.Name: Primordial Core - Rare
1052105.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Boss monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Arcane!" Battle Imagine.
1052105.Description2: A peculiar crystal, with its half-exposed core revealing itself, its power quietly dissipating, as if frozen at the moment of near-completion of sublimation, becoming an unfinished work.

1052106.Name: Immortal Bloom - Rare
1052106.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Boss monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Arcane!" Battle Imagine.
1052106.Description2: An unbloomed bud, but precisely because of its incomplete state, it harbors countless possibilities. Perhaps it was forgotten during its growth, or perhaps it is waiting for the dewdrop to awaken it.

1052107.Name: Mask of Truth and Illusion - Rare
1052107.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Boss monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Arcane!" Battle Imagine.
1052107.Description2: A strange mask with a surface as smooth as uncarved jade. When glimpsed out of the corner of the eye, the faces of heroes, clowns, and saints appear one after another. When stared at fixedly, all visions vanish, leaving only that jade-like emptiness.

1052108.Name: Quicksand of Constant Change - Rare
1052108.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Boss monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Arcane!" Battle Imagine.
1052108.Description2: A handful of floating golden sand, flowing like liquid sunlight. Forever escaping, yet forever coalescing. No container can hold it, yet it lingers and ripples so realistically between the fingers.

1052109.Name: Rubbing of Silence - Rare
1052109.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Boss monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Arcane!" Battle Imagine.
1052109.Description2: A deep, dark stone fragment with a rough, textured surface, as if born from destruction itself. Upon touching it, you can hear the shriek of collapsing stars, a sound that exceeds all limits before collapsing into eternal silence.

1052110.Name: Microcosmic Dewdrop - Rare
1052110.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Boss monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Arcane!" Battle Imagine.
1052110.Description2: It appears as a floating, translucent droplet of water, yet it exudes an unsettling presence that transcends reality. An observer's gaze cannot linger on its surface and is instead forcibly drawn into the inward-collapsing space within. There, a miniature cosmic nebula loops endlessly along a rational trajectory.

1052111.Name: Prism of Light and Shadow - Rare
1052111.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Boss monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Arcane!" Battle Imagine.
1052111.Description2: A cold, crystal-like wedge with razor-sharp edges that seem to exist beyond normal logic, breaking the usual rules of how light spreads. Light passing through it doesn't form a gentle rainbow. Instead, the middle tones are stripped away, leaving only pure brightness and deep darkness. It feels as if that sharp edge quietly redraws the line between the "known" and the "unknown".

1052112.Name: Crystal of Rise and Fall - Rare
1052112.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Boss monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Arcane!" Battle Imagine.
1052112.Description2: A crystalline molted shell formed from an ancient creature on the verge of evolution. The upper half is a thin, wing-like crystal membrane, still glowing with the light of ascension, while the lower half is deeply charred and decayed, like stone worn down by time. These two opposing states do not tear it apart; instead, they are frozen together in a single moment, forming a crystal that records both rise and fall.

1052200.Name: Source Energy
1052200.Description: A rare material, mainly used for crafting Stunt-type Battle Imagines.
1052200.Description2: A wondrous orb of energy, believed to awaken the latent potential slumbering within.

1052201.Name: Brand of Chaos
1052201.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Elite monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is a rare material mainly used for crafting "Stunt!" Battle Imagine.
1052201.Description2: A strange mark, the pattern seems to have life. Rather than saying the pattern of the mark is sloppy, it is more like some kind of unfinished evolution, with potential that has not been fully released.

1052202.Name: Amber of Time
1052202.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Elite monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is a rare material mainly used for crafting "Expertise Skill" Battle Imagine.
1052202.Description2: A strange amber stone that evokes a sense of familiarity in anyone, yet they forget when it appeared, hastily picking it up and carrying it closely, hoping to one day recover the lost memory.

1052203.Name: Prism of Illusion
1052203.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Elite monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is a rare material mainly used for crafting "Expertise Skill" Battle Imagine.
1052203.Description2: A peculiar thread, interwoven with colors, as if the rainbow after the rain has been shattered and re-woven. Even the most skilled weaver cannot replicate its brilliance. It seems to have slipped through a gap in some illusion, quietly arriving with the lingering warmth of thoughts.

1052204.Name: Shreds of Reality
1052204.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Elite monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is a rare material mainly used for crafting "Expertise Skill" Battle Imagine.
1052204.Description2: A peculiar wisp of ash, formed from the supercritical state of an object that has endured destruction beyond its limits. When touched, it gives a sense of falling into an abyss, as if some remnants of disaster still linger.

1052205.Name: Primordial Core
1052205.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Elite monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is a rare material mainly used for crafting "Expertise Skill" Battle Imagine.
1052205.Description2: A peculiar crystal, with its half-exposed core revealing itself, its power quietly dissipating, as if frozen at the moment of near-completion of sublimation, becoming an unfinished work.

1052206.Name: Immortal Bloom
1052206.Description: Obtainable from loot dropped after defeating the corresponding Elite monster in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults. It is a rare material mainly used for crafting "Expertise Skill" Battle Imagine.
1052206.Description2: An unbloomed bud, but precisely because of its incomplete state, it harbors countless possibilities. Perhaps it was forgotten during its growth, or perhaps it is waiting for the dewdrop to awaken it.

1052207.Name: Mask of Truth and Illusion
1052207.Description: After defeating the corresponding elite monsters in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults, there is a chance to obtain it from the loot. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Stunt!" Battle Imagines.
1052207.Description2: A strange mask with a surface as smooth as uncarved jade. When glimpsed out of the corner of the eye, the faces of heroes, clowns, and saints appear one after another. When stared at fixedly, all visions vanish, leaving only that jade-like emptiness.

1052208.Description: After defeating the corresponding elite monsters in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults, there is a chance to obtain it from the loot. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Stunt!" Battle Imagines.
1052208.Description2: A handful of floating golden sand, flowing like liquid sunlight. Forever escaping, yet forever coalescing. No container can hold it, yet it lingers and ripples so realistically between the fingers.

1052213.Description: After defeating the corresponding elite monsters in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults, there is a chance to obtain it from the loot. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Stunt!" Battle Imagines.

1052214.Name: A-Class Overworld Monster Drop 14
1052214.Description: After defeating the corresponding elite monsters in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults, there is a chance to obtain it from the loot. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Stunt!" Battle Imagines.

1052215.Name: A-Class Overworld Monster Drop 15
1052215.Description: After defeating the corresponding elite monsters in the wild or in the Stimen Vaults, there is a chance to obtain it from the loot. It is an exquisite material mainly used for crafting "Stunt!" Battle Imagines.

1052301.Name: Goblin Mane
1052301.Description: Goblin Mane Drop, commonly used for crafting Battle Imagines.
1052301.Description2: Brightly colored, dense and lush. It is said that the mane is an important feature of goblins, so goblins carefully groom it to maintain its best condition.

1052302.Name: Goblin Fang
1052302.Description: Goblin Tooth Drop, commonly used for crafting Battle Imagines.
1052302.Description2: Goblin Fangs are densely and irregularly arranged, allowing them to better tear into opponents during combat and enlarge wounds.

1052303.Name: Goblin Tail
1052303.Description: The tail dropped by goblins is often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052303.Description2: Some researchers point out that intelligent goblins may swing their tails to make deceptive movements to mislead enemies.

1052304.Name: Muku Nail
1052304.Description: The claw dropped by Muku is often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052304.Description2: Muku's hunting weapon is curved and sharp, with fine serrated edges at the tip, used to hook enemies or cut food.

1052305.Name: Muku's Pelt
1052305.Description: The fur dropped by Muku is often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052305.Description2: Muku's fur has a deep hue, covering Muku's scarred skin. It feels warm and comfortable, not only an excellent tool for keeping warm but sometimes even serving as armor to block unexpected attacks.

1052306.Name: Lizardman's Hidden Pearl
1052306.Description: The hidden pearl dropped by lizardmen is often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052306.Description2: A brilliant A-grade pearl, obviously looted from some unlucky merchant's goods...

1052307.Name: Brigand's Gloves
1052307.Description: The gloves dropped by Brigands are often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052307.Description2: The gloves worn by Brigands are exceptionally sturdy and durable because they generally master a cunning weapon-holding technique. Losing their weapon often means a drastic reversal of the situation, with unimaginable consequences.

1052308.Name: Brigand's Sword
1052308.Description: The sharp sword dropped by Brigands is often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052308.Description2: The blades used by Brigands, although not as sharp as standard weapons, are lightweight and easy to handle. Even a swordsmanship idiot can easily get the hang of it.

1052309.Name: Dark Mist Badge
1052309.Description: The badge dropped by enemies of the Dark Mist Legion is often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052309.Description2: A legion badge used to identify one's identity.

1052310.Name: Mighty Colossus's Claw
1052310.Description: The claw dropped by Mighty Colossuses is often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052310.Description2: Sharp and massive claws that can crush enemies with their weight alone.

1052311.Name: Soft Beast Fur
1052311.Description: The soft beast fur dropped during Monster Hunts is often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052311.Description2: High-quality beast fur, fine and fluffy, with a warm touch.

1052312.Name: Boarrier Tusk
1052312.Description: The sturdy tusk dropped by Boarriers, often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052312.Description2: The sharp fang, said to have inspired the ramming prow of warships.

1052313.Name: Skyfish's Giant Fin
1052313.Description: The giant wing dropped by Skyfish, often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052313.Description2: Broad as a sail, extremely resilient, shining with a dazzling luster, but unfortunately inedible.

1052314.Name: Bzzar Wing
1052314.Description: The wing dropped by bees, often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052314.Description2: Thin and transparent, covered with fine patterns, someone once tried to make similar wings with beeswax, attempting to touch the sky.

1052315.Name: Arachnocrab's Shell
1052315.Description: The shell dropped by Arachnocrabs, often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052315.Description2: The hard chitinous shell, covered with dense scratches proving its sturdiness and reliability.

1052316.Name: Caprahorn's Horn
1052316.Description: The horn dropped by Caprahorns, often used to create Battle Imagines.
1052316.Description2: In Asterleeds, a complete Caprahorn's Horn is considered a trophy by adventurers.

1052317.Name: Foxen's Tail
1052317.Description: A tail from a Foxen, commonly used to craft Battle Imagines.
1052317.Description2: A supple and flexible tail, rumored to sense even the faintest tremors in the world's ley lines.

1052318.Name: Goblin's Claw
1052318.Description: A claw from a Goblin, commonly used to craft Battle Imagines.
1052318.Description2: A sharp, dust-covered claw that carries the distinct savagery of a Goblin.

1052319.Name: Blackstone Legion Directive
1052319.Description: An order sheet from the Blackstone Legion, commonly used to craft Battle Imagines.
1052319.Description2: An order sheet bearing the duchy's insignia. Though the paper has yellowed, it still emanates an oppressive aura.

1052320.Name: Caprahorn Wool
1052320.Description: Wool from the Caprahorns of the Bahamar Highlands, commonly used to craft Battle Imagines.
1052320.Description2: Fine, soft wool that's warm to the touch. When rolled into a ball, it becomes a toy beloved by children.

1052321.Name: Special Cabbage Compass
1052321.Description: A special compass from the Cabbage Squad, commonly used to craft Battle Imagines.
1052321.Description2: This standard-issue survey team equipment is far more reliable than its name suggests.

1052322.Name: Lizard's Tail
1052322.Description: A tail from a Lizard, commonly used to craft Battle Imagines.
1052322.Description2: It still shows faint signs of life, twitching at the slightest touch... Is it still alive?!

1052323.Name: Arachnocrab's Pincer
1052323.Description: A pincer from an Arachnocrab, commonly used to craft Battle Imagines.
1052323.Description2: Arachnocrabs are far more emotionally expressive than their appearance suggests. Their pincers are used not only for hunting, but also for expressing their mood. If your hand gets pricked while rummaging through a backpack, it might just mean it's still sulking.

1052324.Name: Boar Hide
1052324.Description: The thick hide of a boar, commonly used to craft Battle Imagines.
1052324.Description2: Though covered in dirt and scratches, it is still tough enough to withstand the slashes of an amateur swordsman.

1052325.Name: Oculopod Lens
1052325.Description: Lens dropped by a mechanical unit, commonly used to craft Battle Imagines.
1052325.Description2: The component most likely to be recovered intact after an Oculopod is destroyed.

1052326.Name: Biting Fluff
1052326.Description: The fluff dropped by a certain creature, commonly used to craft Battle Imagines.
1052326.Description2: Full of bestial nature, it exudes a dense wild aura, making it an excellent disguise when infiltrating beast territory.

1052327.Name: Boastful Collar Mane
1052327.Description: Mane dropped by a Flesh Colossus, commonly used to craft Battle Imagines.
1052327.Description2: Legend says that every time it defeated an opponent, its owner would casually comb the tuft of fur on its chest with a hint of pride. Over time, it took on a smooth, glossy sheen.

1052401.Name: Fire Crystal Shard Lv.1
1052401.Description: Can be obtained during Monster Hunts, and after precise processing, it can be used for Alchemy. It is a basic material.
1052401.Description2: A crystal rich in Engram. Easy to collect and process. Due to absorbing Engram from the atmosphere and underground during crystallization, its specific composition and shape vary by region.

1052425.Name: Lizard Spine Fire Crystal Shard
1052425.Description: Can be obtained by defeating monsters and is used in Alchemy. A basic material.
1052425.Description2: This chip radiates a scorching aura and is fiery to the touch.

1052426.Name: Lizard Spine Ice Crystal Shard
1052426.Description: Can be obtained by defeating monsters and is used in Alchemy. A basic material.
1052426.Description2: Its surface is coated in frost, and touching it feels as bone-chilling as ice.

1052427.Name: Lizard Spine Thunder Crystal Shard
1052427.Description: Can be obtained by defeating monsters and is used in Alchemy. A basic material.
1052427.Description2: The surface of this chip occasionally flashes with light, accompanied by a faint electrical current.

1052428.Name: Lizard Spine Wind Crystal Shard
1052428.Description: Can be obtained by defeating monsters and is used in Alchemy. A basic material.
1052428.Description2: As light as a feather, this chip flows with the very essence of the wind.

1052429.Name: Lizard Spine Rock Crystal Shard
1052429.Description: Can be obtained by defeating monsters and is used in Alchemy. A basic material.
1052429.Description2: More solid and coarse than other chips, this one carries the heavy presence of rock and earth.

1052430.Name: Lizard Spine Forest Crystal Shard
1052430.Description: Can be obtained by defeating monsters and is used in Alchemy. A basic material.
1052430.Description2: A chip infused with the Forest Element, emitting the faint, fresh scent of grass and trees.

1052431.Name: Lizard Spine Light Crystal Shard
1052431.Description: Can be obtained by defeating monsters and is used in Alchemy. A basic material.
1052431.Description2: A translucent and pure chip, concealing the power of light within.

1052432.Name: Lizard Spine Dark Crystal Shard
1052432.Description: Can be obtained by defeating monsters and is used in Alchemy. A basic material.
1052432.Description2: This dimly colored chip seems to devour the surrounding light, piece by piece.

1052501.Name: Shiny Fine Thread
1052501.Description: Can be obtained during Monster Hunts, used to make clothing and accessories.
1052501.Description2: Goblin Mane, can be processed to greatly expand its uses.

1052502.Name: Hard Scrap
1052502.Description: Can be obtained during Monster Hunts, used to make clothing and accessories.
1052502.Description2: Muku's dropped claw, can be processed to greatly expand its uses.

1052503.Name: Brigand's Gloves
1052503.Description: Can be obtained during Monster Hunts, used to make clothing and accessories.
1052503.Description2: Brigand's dropped glove, can be processed to greatly expand its uses.

1052504.Name: Soft Feather
1052504.Description: Can be obtained during Monster Hunts, used to make clothing and accessories.
1052504.Description2: Light and soft, can be processed to greatly expand its uses.

1052505.Name: Iron Scrap
1052505.Description: Can be obtained during Monster Hunts, used to make clothing and accessories.
1052505.Description2: Although rusty, skillful craftsmen and artisans can always turn waste into treasure.

1052506.Name: Broken Arrow
1052506.Description: It can be obtained during Monster Hunts and can be used to make clothing and accessories, as well as Battle Imagines. It is a Raw Material.
1052506.Description2: Although it seems useless, skillful craftsmen and artisans can always turn waste into treasure.

1052507.Name: Crystal Shard
1052507.Description: It can be obtained during Monster Hunts and can be used to make clothing and accessories, as well as Battle Imagines. It is a Raw Material.
1052507.Description2: Even just a fragment of a crystal still has certain processing value.

1052508.Name: Messy Fur
1052508.Description: It can be obtained during Monster Hunts and can be used to make clothing and accessories, as well as Battle Imagines. It is a Raw Material.
1052508.Description2: Although it looks a bit absurd, it is indeed affordable and durable.

1052509.Name: Damaged Claw
1052509.Description: It can be obtained during Monster Hunts and can be used to make clothing and accessories, as well as Battle Imagines. It is a Raw Material.
1052509.Description2: It seems... still retains good hardness, can be processed to greatly expand its uses.

1052510.Name: Soft Shell
1052510.Description: It can be obtained during Monster Hunts and can be used to make clothing and accessories, as well as Battle Imagines. It is a Raw Material.
1052510.Description2: Although it seems useless, skillful craftsmen and artisans can always turn waste into treasure.

1061098.Name: Xeno Mimic
1061098.Description2:
"Data sync complete. Mimetic Core linked."
A mysterious armor from an uncharted astral realm. Its surface, woven from bioadaptive metal, reshapes itself, becoming a second heart to its wearer. In this moment, you become the will of a star, igniting the light that turns fate on its head.

1061099.Name: Awakened Drive
1061099.Description2: Battle will fully activated. Core Drive sealed within deep protocols released. The armor reconstructs itself through high-energy resonance. With all primal constraints lifted, a surge of extraordinary perception and power floods into every nerve of the wearer. In this moment, you are no longer the controller, but the will of the Core Drive itself.

1061100.Name: Disorder Mimic
1061100.Description2:
"Warning: Core malfunction. Void sequence initiated."
What's been corrupted is not only the Mimetic Core, but also the once-unyielding battle will. The armor has fallen into disorder, its radiance twisted, its reason shattered. Now, it protects no one. It roars only for destruction.

It's the rhythm of unspoken words, a song woven from forgotten wishes.

No audience, no applause, only dance steps that continue in the night: Arriving as promised, never ceasing.

1061173.Description2:
Feathered blossoms scatter through the jade-bright night, as the cold bites, the moon wanes and rounds. Beyond the curtain, the east wind blows, then falls still again. Fish-and-dragon lantern dances unfold, silks and finery layer upon layer, all signs of a festival in peaceful times.
Pepper-blossom and cypress wine flush the cheeks with red, as old peachwood charms are torn away for new. Who would believe the withered branches already brim with urgent spring? One crisp, sudden sound fills half the window with crimson glow, shaking loose the snow from the treetop tips.

1070204.Description:
Exchange for a variety of special rewards in this season's "Astral Store", including crafting materials for crossover Battle Wills, Spirit Echo - Happy, and Spirit Echo - Carla.

After the crossover event ends, you can visit Meownia at the Cat's Eye Emporium in Starland to recycle them into Astral Encounter Remnant - Fiery at a 1:4 ratio.
1070204.Description2: A crystal that seals fragments of an astral journey, occasionally reflecting flames' flicker and starlight's trail.

1070001.Name: Rename Card
1070001.Description: An important item issued by the Pioneer Bureau for adventurers to rename.

1070002.Name: Talent Reset Voucher
1070002.Description: Use to reset the activated talents. The feeling of sudden inspiration is wonderful, but there are always moments of regret for impulsiveness. Don't worry, there's another chance.

1070003.Name: Elite Loot Key
1070003.Description:
Participating in defeating elite monsters in the wild will cause an Elite Loot to drop. This item is required to open the chest. In addition to loot, elite monsters also drop EXP, Season Points, Luno, and have a chance to drop rare monster materials.
Refreshes daily from 05:00 to 05:10 (UTC-2). Amount: 2
If you hold more than 6, you will no longer automatically receive them each day.

1070004.Name: Boss Loot Key
1070004.Description:
Participating in defeating a boss monster in the wildness will drop a boss Loot. This item is required to open it. Whether you have a key or not, participating in defeating the boss grants additional loot rewards. Team participation is recommended. In addition to chests, boss monsters also drop EXP, season points, Luno, and have a chance to drop rare monster materials and gear.
Refreshes daily from 05:00 to 05:10(UTC-2). Amount: 2
Max Stack: 6

1070005.Name: Outfit Redem Voucher
1070005.Description: Use to exchange for exquisite appearance outfits at the advanced outfit exchange in Asterleeds.

1070006.Name: Guild Token
1070006.Description: Guild Token obtained by participating in Guild activities. Can be exchanged for items at the Grocery Store.

1070008.Name: Alloy Shard
1070008.Description: After collecting enough alloy shards, you can go to the Artisan Guild and exchange them for Lv.40 Epic gear at the gear forging Artisan Harvey.
1070008.Description2: This alloy is smelted from materials from powerful monsters and rare minerals, capable of reacting to Engram and emitting a flickering glow. Due to its unique research value, it is highly favored by experts on the Bapharian Legacy.

1070009.Name: Keystone of Destiny
1070009.Description: Inserting it into the hero instance activation device can grant additional rewards after completion, and other Allies also have a chance to compete for rewards.

1070010.Name: Luno Amber
1070010.Description: Due to the rarity of Luno made from rare metals, some merchants began trading with polished amber, which gradually came to be known as Luno Amber. Although it is not recognized by official trading centers, Luno Amber is still indispensable for adventurers, providing significant help during growth and adventures.

1070011.Name: Meowlux Premium Card
1070011.Description: After being collected, it can be exchanged for limited edition clothing and hairstyles in the Premium Store.
1070011.Description2: The renowned Meowlux Merchant Guild in Asterleeds releases a limited number of premium cards each season. These cards can be used to purchase seasonal clothing, jewelry, and specially customized hairstyles designed by the chamber's studios. Due to their limited issuance, these cards are highly sought after and extremely valuable.

1070012.Name: Meowlux Vault Card
1070012.Description: After being collected, it can be exchanged for precious items, design blueprints, etc., in the Vault Store.
1070012.Description2: The renowned Meowlux Merchant Guild in Asterleeds offers a special Vault Card for purchasing various goods and merchandise in their stores as a token of appreciation to their customers.

1070013.Name: Module Component
1070013.Description: Usually obtained by dismantling enhanced modules. Rumored to be collectible and redeemable for a complete module.

1070014.Name: Advanced Module Component
1070014.Description: Usually obtained by dismantling enhanced modules. Rumored to be collectible and redeemable for a complete module.

1070015.Name: Perfect Component
1070015.Description: Fragments of a perfect module, rumored to be collected by someone, can be used to exchange for a perfect module.

1070016.Name: Emblem Initialization Tech
1070016.Description: Use to reset the activated Emblem scheme.
1070016.Description2: The feeling of sudden inspiration is wonderful, but there are always moments of regret from impulsiveness. Don't worry, there's another chance.

1070017.Name: Refresh Voucher
1070017.Description: Use to refresh items in the Mystery Store, with daily usage limits.

1070018.Name: Meowlux Wish Coin
1070018.Description: Use the Wish Coin to perform a Wish. Rewards include limited edition mounts, outfits, accessories, design blueprints, dye materials, and a chance to receive Meowlux Guild's Premium Card and Vault Card.
1070018.Description2: It is worth mentioning that the Meowlux Premium Card itself is a valuable item, allowing you to purchase seasonal outfits, jewelry, and specially customized hairstyles designed by the Guild's studios.

1070019.Name: Solar Radiance
1070019.Description: A delicate corona filled with warmth, seemingly containing the radiance of the sun. Collect a certain amount to exchange for rare appearance honor rewards, showcasing your unique charm!

1070020.Name: Asteria Reputation
1070020.Description: Use to redeem rewards at the Asteria Reputation Store.
1070020.Description2: In the Continent of Magna, Reputation not only highlights personal achievements but also testifies to your contributions to the continent's development and brave exploration of unknown territories. Every exploration and discovery leaves a lasting and profound mark on this world.

1070021.Name: Season 1 Ultimate Points
1070021.Description:
Earned through Season Pass rewards for the season.
Exchange for limited edition ultimate appearances in the Season Store.

1070022.Name: Advanced Alloy Shard
1070022.Description: Collect a certain amount of Advanced Alloy Shard to exchange for high-perfection Epic Gear at the Artisan Guild's gear shop.

1070023.Name: Hero's Radiance
1070023.Description: Give it to Milia, the Class guide at the Pioneer Bureau, and complete the challenges to unlock a new Class.
1070023.Description2: A gem representing courage and resilience, obtainable only by adventurers who have undergone adventures.

1070024.Name: Auto Combo Instructions
1070024.Description: After use, it will provide "Auto Combo" setup teaching.
1070024.Description2: Records combat techniques that allow adventurers to free their hands better. Take a look at what is written.

1070025.Name: Season Achievement Wish Card
1070025.Description: After use, you can choose 10 silver achievements to complete.

1070026.Name: Stunt Will - Fragment
1070026.Description: Collect a certain number of these shards to exchange for a complete Stunt Will. Stunt Will is the core material for crafting "Stunt!" Battle Imagines.
1070026.Description2: Battle Imagine is the crystallization of thoughts, consciousness, and Engram combined, possessing supernatural powers.

1070027.Name: Heavy Alloy Shard
1070027.Description: After collecting enough Heavy Alloy Shard, you can go to the Artisan Guild and exchange them for level 60 Epic gear at the gear forging Artisan Harvey.
1070027.Description2: This alloy is smelted from materials from powerful monsters and rare minerals, capable of reacting to Engram and emitting a flickering glow. Due to its unique research value, it is highly favored by experts on the Bapharian Legacy.

1070028.Name: Sovereign Alloy Shard
1070028.Description: After collecting enough Sovereign Alloy Shard, you can go to the Artisan Guild and exchange them for level 80 Epic gear at the gear forging Artisan Harvey.
1070028.Description2: This alloy is smelted from materials from powerful monsters and rare minerals, capable of reacting to Engram and emitting a flickering glow. Due to its unique research value, it is highly favored by experts on the Bapharian Legacy.

1070029.Name: Arcane Will - Fragment
1070029.Description: Collecting a certain number of these fragments can be exchanged for a complete Arcane Will. Arcane Will is the core material for creating "Arcane!" Battle Imagines.
1070029.Description2: Battle Imagine is the crystallization of thoughts, consciousness, and Engram combined, possessing supernatural powers.

1070030.Name: Meowlux Wish Coin (Bound)
1070030.Description: Using a Wish coin allows for one Wish, and the prize is guaranteed to be bound. Rewards include limited edition mounts, outfits, accessories, design blueprints, dye materials, and there is also a chance to receive Meowlux Premium Cards and Vault Cards.
1070030.Description2: It is worth mentioning that the Meowlux Premium Card itself is a valuable item, allowing you to purchase seasonal outfits, jewelry, and specially customized hairstyles designed by the Guild's studios.

1070031.Name: Will Wish Coin
1070031.Description: Spend Will Wish Coins to make a wish for a guaranteed bound-item pull. Rewards include the limited Will sets, with chances to earn Will Fragments.

1070032.Name: Runic Alloy Shard
1070032.Description: Material used to exchange for special gear from the Floating Island.
1070032.Description2: A special Alloy Shard infused with mysterious power from the Floating Island, with unknown runes on its surface.

1070033.Name: Void Alloy Shard
1070033.Description: Material used to exchange for special gear from the Floating Island.
1070033.Description2: A special Alloy Shard rich in void energy from the Floating Island, with rune energy visibly surging on its surface.

1070034.Name: Throne (Gold)
1070034.Description: Material used for breakthrough-level enhancement of weapons.
1070034.Description2: A Mystery Metal naturally formed in the Bapharian Ruins. It appears golden but is not a terrestrial mineral. It grows slowly from the walls and domes of the ruins, containing unique Engram not found in surface minerals. It's an exceptionally rare and special material.

1070035.Name: Throne (Pure Gold)
1070035.Description: Material used for breakthrough-level enhancement of weapons. Once the relevant crafting feature is unlocked, collect enough Throne (Pure Gold), then visit Lunel, the Forge Master, to upgrade Lv.80 weapons with 100% perfection to Lv.90 weapons.
1070035.Description2: A Mystery Metal naturally formed in the Bapharian Ruins. It appears golden but is not a terrestrial mineral. It grows slowly from the walls and domes of the ruins, containing unique Engram not found in surface minerals. It's an exceptionally rare and special material.

1070036.Name: Glinting Stellar Core
1070036.Description: Material used for breakthrough-level enhancement of weapon. Once the relevant crafting feature is unlocked, collect Glinting Stellar Cores and Throne (Pure Gold), then visit Lunel, the Forge Master, to upgrade Lv.90 weapons to Lv.100 "Far-Sea" series weapons, which features a special weapon appearance.
1070036.Description2:
Its surface shimmers with rippling luster, flowing with light like waves across the sea.
Infused with Engram and marine energy, it far surpasses terrestrial metals in both conductivity and resilience. Often used in crafting weapons that channel the power of the ocean.

1070038.Name: Magic Wrench
1070038.Description: Use to immediately complete one piece of furniture currently being crafted in the crafting queue.
1070038.Description2: A special wrench custom-made for adventurers by the Artisan Guild. Its precisely calibrated structure allows for instant furniture crafting.

1070039.Name: Dim Lattice
1070039.Description: Collect enough Dim Lattices to exchange for the Void Erosion Weaving Box. Open the Void Erosion Weaving Box to choose one from Shadow Hunter outfit series (Top, Bottom, Gauntlets, Boots, Mouthwear) or Doomlord weapon appearance series.

1070040.Name: Illusionary Rune Alloy - Dreamer
1070040.Description: A special material used to exchange for Lv.140 Dreamer gear sets.
1070040.Description2: Forged from the essences of powerful monsters and rare minerals, this alloy resonates with Engram energy, emanating a faint, wavering light. Its unique research value makes it a coveted item among experts of the Bapharian Legacy.

1070041.Name: Illusionary Rune Alloy - Weaver
1070041.Description: A special material used to exchange for Lv.160 Weaver gear sets.
1070041.Description2: Forged from the essences of powerful monsters and rare minerals, this alloy resonates with Engram energy, emanating a faint, wavering light. Its unique research value makes it a coveted item among experts of the Bapharian Legacy.

1070042.Name: Levigold
1070042.Description: Material used for breakthrough-level enhancement of weapons. Once crafting is available, collect enough "Throne (Pure Gold)" and visit Lunel, the Forge Master, to forge a 100% perfect Lv.80 weapon into an Lv.90 weapon.
1070042.Description2: A Mystery Metal naturally formed in the Bapharian Ruins. It appears golden but is not a terrestrial mineral. It grows slowly from the walls and domes of the ruins, containing unique Engram not found in surface minerals. It's an exceptionally rare and special material.

1070043.Name: Glittering Fluxgold
1070043.Description: Material used for breakthrough-level enhancement of weapons. Once crafting is available, collect enough "Glittering Fluxgold" and visit Lunel, the Forge Master, to forge a 100% perfect Lv.140/160 weapon into an Lv.150/170 weapon.
1070043.Description2: A Mystery Metal naturally formed in the Bapharian Ruins. It appears golden but is not a terrestrial mineral. It grows slowly from the walls and domes of the ruins, containing unique Engram not found in surface minerals. It's an exceptionally rare and special material.

1070044.Name: Illusion Lattice
1070044.Description:
Collect enough Illusion Lattices to exchange for Illusion outfit series (Top, Bottom, Gauntlets, Boots, Mouthwear) or Illusion weapon appearance series.
Related exchanges will become available mid-season during the Dreambloom Season.

1070045.Name: Resonant Alloy Shard
1070045.Description: Collect enough Resonant Alloy Shards and visit Harvey, the gear blacksmith at the Artisan Guild, to exchange them for Lv.120 Epic gear.
1070045.Description2: Forged from the essences of powerful monsters and rare minerals, this alloy resonates with Engram energy, emanating a faint, wavering light. Its unique research value makes it a coveted item among experts of the Bapharian Legacy.

1070048.Name: Bahamar Region Reputation
1070048.Description: Used to redeem rewards in the Bahamar region's Reputation store.
1070048.Description2: On the Continent of Magna, Reputation showcases not only your personal accomplishments, but also your contributions to the pioneering of the continent and your brave exploration of unknown lands. Every exploration and discovery you make leaves a lasting and profound mark on the world.

1070049.Name: Dreamweave Dust
1070049.Description: A universal material used to redeem dungeon-exclusive cosmetics for the "Dreambloom" season from Stella at the Pioneer Bureau. Drops from any Chaotic Realm dungeon during the season. There is a cumulative drop limit of 800 from Normal/Hard modes, and another 800 from Master 1–5. There is no drop limit for Master 6 and above.
1070049.Description2: The faint glimmer left behind by scattered Dreamweave Silk still carries the warmth of a dream yet to awaken.

1070050.Name: Dreamweave Silk - Decay
1070050.Description: A special material used to redeem the "Twilight Rush - Gauntlets" cosmetic—exclusive to the Depths of Decay dungeon during the "Dreambloom" season—from Stella at the Pioneer Bureau. Drops from this dungeon on any difficulty. A cumulative drop limit of 100 applies across all difficulties.
1070050.Description2: Woven in the liminal space between dream and reality, it shimmers with a soft, starlike luster.

1070055.Description2: Woven in the liminal space between dream and reality, it shimmers with a soft, starlike luster.

1070056.Name: Slumberdream Remnant
1070056.Description: Can be obtained in the Slumberdream Valley and exchanged for various items in the Slumberdream Store.

1070057.Name: Slumberdream Crystal
1070057.Description:
Obtained by completing Slumberdream Valley–related quests and by successfully awakening within Slumberdream Valley. Can be exchanged for various progression items in the Slumberdream Store or converted into Slumberdream Remnants.
There is a weekly drop cap in the Slumberdream Valley gameplay. The initial weekly cap is 50; after Hard difficulty is unlocked, the weekly cap increases to 80; after Nightmare difficulty is unlocked, the weekly cap increases to 120. Reaching the drop cap in Slumberdream Valley does not affect acquisition from other sources.

1070058.Name: Slumberdream Feather
1070058.Description: Can be obtained by completing Slumberdream Valley challenge quests and used to exchange for various cosmetic rewards in the Slumberdream Store.

1070059.Name: Dreambloom - Sigil Shard
1070059.Description: After collecting enough, Sigil Shards can be exchanged for various Sigils from Erica at the entrance of the Imagine Research Institute.

1070060.Name: Construct Alloy Shard
1070060.Description: Collect enough Construct Alloy Shards and visit Harvey, the Gear Forge Artisan at the Artisan Guild, to exchange them for Lv.220 Epic gear.
1070060.Description2: This alloy is smelted from materials from powerful monsters and rare minerals, capable of reacting to Engram and emitting a flickering glow. Due to its unique research value, it is highly favored by experts on the Bapharian Legacy.

1070063.Name: Illusory Fluxgold
1070063.Description: Material used for breakthrough-level enhancement of weapons. Once crafting is available, collect enough "Illusory Fluxgold" and visit Lunel, the Forge Master, to forge a 100% perfect Lv.240/260 weapon into a Lv.250/270 weapon.
1070063.Description2: A Mystery Metal naturally formed in the Bapharian Ruins. It appears golden but is not a terrestrial mineral. It grows slowly from the walls and domes of the ruins, containing unique Engram not found in surface minerals. It's an exceptionally rare and special material.

1070064.Name: Ember Rune Alloy - Illusion
1070064.Description: A special material used to exchange for Lv.240 Illusion gear sets.
1070064.Description2: This alloy is smelted from materials from powerful monsters and rare minerals, capable of reacting to Engram and emitting a flickering glow. Due to its unique research value, it is highly favored by experts on the Bapharian Legacy.

1070065.Description2: This alloy is smelted from materials from powerful monsters and rare minerals, capable of reacting to Engram and emitting a flickering glow. Due to its unique research value, it is highly favored by experts on the Bapharian Legacy.

1070066.Name: Dreamvoid Dust
1070066.Description: A universal material used to redeem dungeon-exclusive appearances for the "Echoes of Ember" season from Stella at the Pioneer Bureau. Drops from any Chaotic Realm dungeon during the season. There is a cumulative drop limit of 800 from Normal/Hard modes, and another 800 from Master 1–5. There is no drop limit for Master 6 and above.
1070066.Description2: The warmth of the dream remains, yet it carries the biting chill of waking.

1070067.Name: Dreamvoid Silk - Radiant Tomb
1070067.Description: A special material used to redeem appearances exclusive to the Cursed Radiant Tomb dungeon during the "Echoes of Ember" season—from Stella at the Pioneer Bureau. Drops from this dungeon on any difficulty. A cumulative drop limit of 100 applies across all difficulties. After obtaining the appearances, visit Stella to exchange any remaining Dreamvoid Silk for Dreamvoid Dust.
1070067.Description2: The rift between dream and reality is closing, and the sprawling starlight withdraws its gentleness, as if counting down to an approaching moment.

1070068.Name: Dreamvoid Silk - Processing Facility
1070068.Description: A special material used to redeem appearances exclusive to the Mech Facility dungeon during the "Echoes of Ember" season—from Stella at the Pioneer Bureau.
