Drops from this dungeon on any difficulty. A cumulative drop limit of 900 applies across all difficulties. After obtaining the appearances, visit Stella to exchange any remaining Dreamvoid Silk for Dreamvoid Dust.
1070072.Description2: The rift between dream and reality is closing, and the sprawling starlight withdraws its gentleness, as if counting down to an approaching moment.

1070073.Name: Echoes of Ember - Sigil Shard
1070073.Description: After collecting enough, Sigil Shards can be exchanged for various Sigils from Erica at the entrance of the Imagine Research Institute.

1070074.Name: Meowlux Special Universal Ticket
1070074.Description: Obtained after completing Carnival Periodic Goals. Can be exchanged for Gold Meow Points from any prize pool in the Astral Store.
1070074.Description2: Said to be a gift prepared by the Meowlux Guild for a mysterious VIP. "Only those most valued by Miss Meowclu can receive it..."

1070075.Name: Illusion-Shroud Ash
1070075.Description: Can be obtained in the Illusion-Shroud Woods and exchanged for various items in the Illusion-Shroud Store.

1070076.Name: Illusion-Shroud Essence
1070076.Description:
Obtained by completing Illusion-Shroud Woods-related quests and by successfully awakening within Illusion-Shroud Woods. Can be exchanged for various progression items in the Illusion-Shroud Store or converted into Illusion-Shroud Ash.
There is a weekly drop cap in the Illusion-Shroud Woods gameplay. The initial weekly cap is 50; after Hard difficulty is unlocked, the weekly cap increases to 80; after Nightmare difficulty is unlocked, the weekly cap increases to 120. Reaching the drop cap in Illusion-Shroud Woods does not affect acquisition from other sources.

1070077.Name: Illusion-Shroud Crystal
1070077.Description: Can be obtained by completing Illusion-Shroud Woods quests and used to exchange for various cosmetic rewards in the Illusion-Shroud Store.

1070111.Name: 100 Rose Orb Specific Appearance Coupon (Test)
1070111.Description: 100 Rose Orb Specific Appearance Coupon (Test) Young Wolf, Meowstar Envoy, Earl Grey, and Midnight Rose

1070112.Name: Elder Splasha's Ash Pact
1070112.Description:
Use the Ash Pact or throw it into the Flame of Renewal to claim your reward and increase Blessing Progress.
This item will become unusable after the Void Corruption Frenzy season ends.
1070112.Description2:
Elder Splasha, famed for his fish-like memory, is the ideal confessor...
For repentance and health, offer Elder Splasha's Ash Pact to the Flame of Renewal.

1070113.Name: Elder Voidmind's Ash Pact
1070113.Description:
Use the Ash Pact or throw it into the Flame of Renewal to claim your reward and increase Blessing Progress.
This item will become unusable after the Void Corruption Frenzy season ends.
1070113.Description2:
As the cultivator of the Longevity Tree, Elder Voidmind carries wisdom that reflects time and history.
It's believed that offering Elder Voidmind's Ash Pact to the Flame of Renewal lets wishes for career and love take root and blossom, like the Longevity Tree.

1070114.Name: White Wolf's Ash Pact
1070114.Description:
Use the Ash Pact or throw it into the Flame of Renewal to claim your reward and increase Blessing Progress.
This item will become unusable after the Void Corruption Frenzy season ends.
1070114.Description2:
The White Wolf once protected the tribe through ages past. To the tribe, the White Wolf's blessing means revival from adversity.
When fate falls into shadow, cast the White Wolf's Ash Pact into the Flame of Renewal, and destiny shall turn once more.

1070115.Name: Elder Mushroom's Ash Pact
1070115.Description:
Use the Ash Pact or throw it into the Flame of Renewal to claim your reward and increase Blessing Progress.
This item will become unusable after the Void Corruption Frenzy season ends.
1070115.Description2: Though Elder Mushroom has retreated into the mountains, the tribe still associates her with prosperity, believing that offering Elder Mushroom's Ash Pact into the Flame of Renewal will make wishes for wealth come true.

1070116.Name: Mischief Candy
1070116.Description: A special candy that only appears on the Mischief Night, radiating a wondrous sweetness. Collect them to exchange for limited rewards at Meowlux Candy House.

1070117.Name: Snow's Gift
1070117.Description:
Obtained through the Winterfest event. It can be exchanged for Winterfest gifts at the present pile beside Snoy in Asterleeds Town Gate Square. Each exchange grants random Winterfest toys and Silverleaf Coins, with a chance to also receive the Wishy Fawn - Headwear.
If you have not obtained the Wishy Fawn - Headwear by 5:00 on December 24, 2025, your next exchange is guaranteed to award it.
1070117.Description2: Its sole purpose is to be shared.

1070118.Name: Star Fragment - Premium
1070118.Description: Collect seven to exchange for a complete Meowlux Premium Card, unlocking special privileges just for you. You can also visit <color=#ffe2af>Kalista</color> at the Meowlux Member Shop to recycle them for a certain amount of <color=#eed335>Meowlux Vault Cards (Bound)</color>.

1070119.Name: Renewal Light Wish Coin (Bound)
1070119.Description: Can be used to perform one Renewal Light Wish roll. All rewards are bound. Duplicate appearance rewards can be dismantled or recycled for a certain number of <color=#9cb9ef>Renewal Light Vault Cards</color>, which can be used to exchange for rare items at the Renewal Store.
1070119.Description2: A limited-edition Wish Coin specially minted by the Meowlux Merchant Guild for the festival. This coin can only be used during the Renewal Festival's limited‑time Wish event. After the event ends, Kalista at the Meowlux Member Shop will keep the "Renewal Store" entrance available, where any unused Wish Coins can be exchanged for Renewal Light Vault Cards and related rewards.

1070120.Name: Renewal Light Vault Card
1070120.Description: Obtainable through Gifts of Renewal and Renewal Unfolds. After being collected, it can be exchanged for precious items at the Renewal Store.
1070120.Description2: A limited-edition Wish Coin specially minted by the Meowlux Merchant Guild for the Renewal Festival. This coin can only be used during the limited‑time Wish event. After the event ends, Kalista at the Meowlux Member Shop will keep the "Renewal Store" entrance available, where unused Wish Coins can be exchanged for Renewal Light Vault Cards. and related rewards.

1070121.Name: Renewal Dew
1070121.Description: A valuable item obtained from various gathering activities during the Renewal Festival. Used in the "Gifts of Renewal" quests.
1070121.Description2:
During the Renewal Festival, the arrival of the mysterious Renewal Light subtly alters the ambient Engram, causing a layer of crystal-clear dewdrops with a soft glow to condense on the surface of gathered materials.
These rare dewdrops are known as "Renewal Dew" and are commonly used in festival rituals and gemcrafting processes.

1070122.Description2: A limited-edition Wish Coin specially minted by the Meowlux Merchant Guild for the crossover event. This coin can only be used during the limited‑time Wish event. After the event ends, this item will expire. Visit Kalista at the Meowlux Membership Store to exchange any unused Wish Coins for Luno (Bound).

1070123.Description2: A Vault Card issued alongside the limited-edition Wish Coin. This Vault Card can only be used during the limited‑time Wish event. After the event ends, this item will expire. Visit Kalista at the Meowlux Membership Store to exchange any unused Vault Cards for Luno (Bound).

1070201.Name: Astral Gold Meow Ticket I
1070201.Description: Collect to exchange for limited items at the Astral Store. After the crossover ends, this item will become invalid and can be returned to Meownia at Cat's Eye Emporium in Starland for recycling into Starland Medals.
1070201.Description2: "That's right, it can be exchanged for gifts from another world!"

1071001.Name: Void Corruption Frenzy - Common Achievement Trophy
1071001.Description: A Common Achievement Trophy awarded for completing certain achievements during the Void Corruption Frenzy season. It's required to advance your Title rank for the Void Corruption Frenzy season and cannot be used in subsequent seasons.
1071001.Description2: <color=#e67373>An exclusive season item of Void Corruption Frenzy, now expired.</color>

1071002.Name: Void Corruption Frenzy - Superior Achievement Trophy
1071002.Description: A Superior Achievement Trophy awarded for completing certain achievements during the Void Corruption Frenzy season. It's required to advance your Title rank for the Void Corruption Frenzy season and cannot be used in subsequent seasons.
1071002.Description2: <color=#e67373>An exclusive season item of Void Corruption Frenzy, now expired.</color>

1071003.Name: Honor Proof
1071003.Description: Proof of individual scoring achievements during a certain World Boss Crusade. Besides showing off your strength in the Guild, it doesn't seem to serve much other purpose. Still, you're pretty awesome.

1071004.Name: Dreambloom - Common Achievement Trophy
1071004.Description: A Common Achievement Trophy awarded for completing certain achievements during the Dreambloom season. It's required to advance your Title rank for the Dreambloom season and cannot be used in subsequent seasons.
1071004.Description2: <color=#e67373>An exclusive item for the Dreambloom season, now expired.</color>

1071005.Name: Dreambloom - Superior Achievement Trophy
1071005.Description: A Superior Achievement Trophy awarded for completing certain achievements during the Dreambloom season. It's required to advance your Title rank for the Dreambloom season and cannot be used in subsequent seasons.
1071005.Description2: <color=#e67373>An exclusive item for the Dreambloom season, now expired.</color>

1071006.Name: Echoes of Ember - Common Achievement Trophy
1071006.Description: A Common Achievement Trophy awarded for completing certain achievements during the Echoes of Ember season. It's required to advance your Title rank for the Echoes of Ember season and cannot be used in subsequent seasons.

1073101.Name: Toy - White Fireworks

Approach and tap the button to set off the firework.
Summoned toy lasts 10 minutes.
1073101.Description2:

1. Toy summoning is limited per line. Try switching to another if you've reached the max.
2. Toy count is also limited near each character. Please summon in a more open area if needed.

1073110.Description:
After using the item, the Basic attack button is replaced with the Bubble Blowing button.
Tap the button to start blowing bubbles, and tap the button again to stop. Tap the Exit Toy button to restore the Basic Attack button.

1073111.Name: Toy - Water Spell
1073111.Description:

Casts a Water Spell directly ahead. Tap Exit to restore the Basic Attack button.

1073112.Description:

1073116.Name: Toy - Adorable Sculpture
1073116.Description:

Tap to transform into a majestic statue, and press again to exit statue state. Tap Exit to restore the Basic Attack button.

1073117.Description:

1073123.Description:

1073124.Description:

1073125.Description:

Tap the button to release a handheld firework once. Tap Exit to restore the Basic Attack button.

1073126.Name: Toy - Frost Beam
1073126.Description:
After using the item, Basic Attack button is replaced with Frostbeam Magic.
After release, a Frostbeam is fired straight ahead of the character, and players hit will be inflicted with a frozen state. Tap Exit to restore the Basic Attack button.

1073127.Name: Toy - Cute Reading Pose
1073127.Description:
After using the item, the Basic Attack button is replaced with the Switch to Reading State button.
Tap the button to start reading, and tap the button again to exit the reading state. Tap Exit Toy to restore the Basic Attack button.

1073128.Name: Toy - Bouncing Device
1073128.Description:
Summon a bouncing device in front of you.
Springs you sky-high.
The summoned toy lasts 10 minutes.
1073128.Description2:
Attention:
1. This toy cannot be used inside dungeons.
2. Toy summoning is limited per area. Try switching to another if you've reached the max.
3. Toy count is also limited near each character. Please summon in a more open area if needed.

1073129.Name: Toy - Land Explorer
1073129.Description:
Summon a "Land Explorer" in front of you.
You can jump in and swim freely inside it.
The summoned toy lasts 10 minutes.
1073129.Description2:
Attention:
1. Each player can only summon a maximum of 3 of these toys at once.
2. This is an obstruction-type toy. You can toggle whether you're affected by other players' obstruction toys in the Settings menu.
3. This toy cannot be used inside dungeons.
4. Toy summoning is limited per area. Try switching to another if you've reached the max.
5. Toy count is also limited near each character. Please summon in a more open area if needed.

1073130.Name: Toy - Small Light Bridge
1073130.Description:
Summon a small light bridge above your head.
You can hop on and play freely across the Light Bridge.
The summoned toy lasts 30 minutes.
1073130.Description2:
Attention:
1. This is an obstruction-type toy. You can toggle whether you're affected by other players' obstruction toys in the Settings menu.
2. This toy cannot be used inside dungeons.
3. Toy summoning is limited per area. Try switching to another if you've reached the max.
4. Toy count is also limited near each character. Please summon in a more open area if needed.

1073132.Name: Toy - Mischief Pumpkin
1073132.Description:
Transform into a Mischief Pumpkin.
Tap "Exit" to return to your human form.
This item cannot be used in dungeons.

1073133.Name: Toy - Snowman Summoner
1073133.Description:
Obtained from the Winterfest event. Transform into a snowman. TheBasic Attack button is replaced with Snowball Throw, and the Special Attack button is replaced with Snowball Rolling. When used in the Nappo Hunt activity, it allows you to deal damage to Snow Nappo.
Tap "Exit" to return to your human form.
This item cannot be used in dungeons.
1073133.Description2:
"Want to summon a perfect snowman? Congratulations, you are the snowman! "
A Beekman Sugar Refinery creation, bringing surprises to every Winterfest.

1073134.Name: Toy - Winterfest Morph Card I
1073134.Description:
Obtained from the Winterfest event. Transform into a random Winterfest decoration. The Basic Attack button is replaced with a Freeze button.
Tap the button to remain frozen in place; tap it again to unfreeze. Tap "Exit" to return to your human form.
This item cannot be used in dungeons.
1073134.Description2: A Winterfest-exclusive gift. Beneath its gorgeous wrapping lies a little secret sure to lift your spirits.

1073135.Name: Toy - Winterfest Morph Card II
1073135.Description:
Obtained from the Winterfest event. Transform into a random Winterfest decoration. The Basic Attack button is replaced with a Freeze button.
Tap the button to remain frozen in place; tap it again to unfreeze. Tap "Exit" to return to your human form.
This item cannot be used in dungeons.
1073135.Description2: A Winterfest-exclusive gift. Beneath its gorgeous wrapping lies a little secret sure to lift your spirits.

1073136.Name: Mangan Transform - Improvised
1073136.Description:
Transform into a random Mangan mahjong tile.
Tap "Exit" to return to your human form.
This item cannot be used in dungeons.
1073136.Description2: Forget the rulebook. Use it to transform into Ee-chan or Nappo—whichever one your instinct picks in the moment!

1073137.Name: Toy - Coin Launcher
1073137.Description:
After using the item, the Basic Attack button is replaced with the Coin Launch button.
Tap the button to launch a coin. Attacking the summoned coin multiple times makes it grow larger. When the coin disappears, the user is granted a Coin Aura effect. Tap the Exit Toy button to restore the Basic Attack button.
1073137.Description2: A special gift for the Springfest. Surely you remember wishing your red envelopes were bigger when you were a child!

1073138.Name: Toy - Skyrocket Firework
1073138.Description:
After using this item, the Basic Attack button is replaced with the Firework Launch button.
Tap the button to start launching fireworks. The Special Attack button is then replaced with the Firework Detonate button. Tap the Exit Toy button to restore the Basic Attack button.
1073138.Description2: An exclusive gift for the Springfest. Experience fireworks in a whole new way!

1073139.Name: Toy - Heartfelt Beam
1073139.Description:
After using the item, the Basic Attack button is replaced with the Heartfelt Beam button.
Tap the button to fire a charming beam. After using the Heartfelt Beam skill five times, the toy will be automatically unequipped. Tap the Exit Toy button to restore the Basic Attack button.
1073139.Description2: An exclusive Valentine's Day toy. Go share your charm with someone special!

1073140.Name: Toy - Full of Affection
1073140.Description:
After using the item, the Basic Attack button is replaced with the Full of Affection button.
Tap the button to become filled with affection. Tap the Exit Toy button to restore the Basic Attack button.
1073140.Description2: An exclusive Valentine's Day toy. Perfect for expressing affection in front of someone special.

1073141.Name: Boom-Boom Ea-chan I

1073141.Description2: Become a member of the Ea-chan Drum Band! March to the rhythmic "boom-boom" and show off your style!

1077001.Name: Luminous Tsubaki - Swallow Counter
1077001.Description: Can unlock skill effect Luminous Tsubaki - Swallow Counter.
1077001.Description2:
Luminous Tsubaki: A faint light, like the cold moon, flows along the blade. The moment the ​Iaido Slash​ lands, camellia petals and frost shatter together, like a phantom wilting in the night mist.
Swallow Counter: The dual slashes of the dash tear through the air, scarlet cherry blossoms burning out along their trajectory, like two red swallows streaking across the battlefield, leaving only scorching ashes and scattered flower souls.

1077002.Name: Sakura Maelstrom - Floral Hailstorm
1077002.Description: Can unlock skill effect Sakura Maelstrom - Floral Hailstorm.
1077002.Description2:
Sakura Maelstrom: The flash moment the bowstring twangs, multiple arrows, wrapped in a downpour of cherry blossoms, are unleashed. Each arrow blooms into a small crimson vortex along its flight path.
Floral Hailstorm: The arrowheads transform into an unceasing meteor shower of cherry blossoms. The dense barrage makes an unending crimson snow fall from the sky.

1077003.Name: Vermilion Spell - Radiant Falling Petals
1077003.Description: Can unlock skill effect Vermilion Spell - Radiant Falling Petals.
1077003.Description2:
Vermilion Spell: Ice crystals gather at the staff's tip like blood-red cherry blossoms, finally exploding into thorn-like icicles. The forbidden prayers of a divine sorceress can be faintly heard amidst the cold air.
Radiant Falling Petals: A laser erupts from the top of the staff, with cherry blossoms and sunset glow intertwining along its path to form a ribbon of light, like a scarlet thread cast upon the mortal world by Amaterasu's loom.

1077004.Name: Petal Storm - Cicada Flash
1077004.Description: Can unlock skill effect Petal Storm - Cicada Flash.
1077004.Description2:
Petal Storm: The spear thrust is too fast to see its physical form, only afterimages like a hailstorm of cherry blossoms explode in the air, as if bombarding continuously with the entire spring as ammunition.
Cicada Flash: A diving spear attack from high above tears through the clouds. Upon landing, it kicks up a ring-shaped shockwave of cherry blossoms. Cicada-wing-shaped energy fragments hover and flicker at the epicenter of the blast.

1077005.Name: Emerald Vines - Crimson Halo
1077005.Description: Can unlock skill effect Emerald Vines - Crimson Halo.
1077005.Description2:
Emerald Vines: As the spell ring rotates, thorny vines erupt from the void. Cherry blossom branches transform into a strangling cage of thorns for the enemy, each leaf blade stained with a thin layer of red blood-dew.
Crimson Halo: The healing aura ripples out like water waves, pink petals continuously falling within its range. The bloodstains of the injured are gently dyed the color of wilting cherry blossoms.

1077006.Name: Octave Snowfall - Sakura Ichimonoji
1077006.Description: Can unlock skill effect Octave Snowfall - Sakura Ichimonoji.
1077006.Description2:
Octave Snowfall: Cherry blossoms entwine into an eightfold illusion. The moment of impact, ice crystals and petals explode into a hailstorm, carving a bloody falling blossom emblem onto the enemy.
Sakura Ichimonoji: The slash of the blade cuts open the night curtain. Cherry blossoms rapidly grow and then wilt along the sword mark, as if drawing a final "One" on the battlefield with a crimson ink brush.

1077007.Name: Sakurani Slash - Mountain Shatterer
1077007.Description: Can unlock skill effect Sakurani Slash - Mountain Shatterer.
1077007.Description2:
Sakurani Slash: The blade is entwined with an ominous storm of cherry blossoms. Each spinning slash unleashes a crimson tide, as if an ogre is smashing an entire cherry forest down upon the mortal world.
Mountain Shatterer: The moment the giant blade smashes into the ground, rocks and cherry petal fragments explode together. Boiling crimson flower mud surges from the fissures of the cracked earth.

1077008.Name: Hanami Frenzy - Sakura's Touch
1077008.Description: Can unlock skill effect: Hanami Frenzy - Sakura's Touch.
1077008.Description2:
Hanami Frenzy: As you leap and slash, your guitar bursts with brilliant sakura sound waves. The entire sakura forest whirls with each strike. Sound and blade intertwine into a melody of battle passion.
Sakura's Touch: With a gentle pluck of the strings, pale pink petals drift with the notes. The soft melody turns into a healing light, easing your allies' pain.

1077009.Name: Shadowflash
1077009.Description2: A gleam rides the edge, slicing the night's feathers and vanishing through split-second malice.

1077010.Name: Thornspire Waltz
1077010.Description: Unlocks the Thornspire Waltz skill effect.
1077010.Description2: Steel shines by night, chaining strikes into desire. Even crows hush, moonlight gilding the black in a wordless waltz.

1077011.Name: Gravistar Field
1077011.Description: Unlocks the Gravistar Field skill effect.
1077011.Description2: A black meteor falls like myth itself, whispering, murmuring, striking like a crow and raising winds of dread.

1077012.Name: Meditative Storm
1077012.Description: Unlocks the Meditative Storm skill effect.
1077012.Description2: Thought and meditation converge into a storm that sweeps with annihilating force.

1077013.Name: Umbral Surge
1077013.Description: Unlocks the Umbral Surge skill effect.
1077013.Description2: Dark energy hidden in the spell ring erupts like bullets, wreathed in black light and shedding dark feathers.

1077014.Name: Domain of Night
1077014.Description: Unlocks the Domain of Night skill effect.
1077014.Description2: Night grants its chosen ground. All who enter are blessed.

1077015.Name: Nightfall Suppression
1077015.Description: Unlocks the Nightfall Suppression skill effect.
1077015.Description2: Wrath amasses gloom then falls as a curtain. Stone sentinels rising to undo all schemes.

1077016.Name: Bulwark Forcefield
1077016.Description: Unlocks the Bulwark Forcefield skill effect.
1077016.Description2: A titanic slam hurls boulders skyward. Black rocks rain down, terrifying the weak.

1077017.Name: Stillwind
1077017.Description2: A summoned wind ring denies all. No wing crosses. Only plumes remain.

1077018.Name: Orbit Crash
1077018.Description: Unlocks the Orbit Crash skill effect.
1077018.Description2: A vaulting lance lifts the night. On impact, it rends the sky, with black light flooding earth as feathers erupt in praise.

1077019.Name: Meteor Annihilation
1077019.Description: Unlocks the Meteor Annihilation skill effect.
1077019.Description2: Ravens calls and feathers answer as weapons, guarding all beneath the dark.

1077020.Name: Blackcloud Barrage
1077020.Description: Unlocks the Blackcloud Barrage skill effect.
1077020.Description2: Black feathers fire as arrows, ripping the sky and leaving shadows to fade as they pin the battlefield.

1077021.Name: Edict Ring
1077021.Description: Unlocks the Edict Ring skill effect.
1077021.Description2: A sweeping blade cuts through the wind of night, the Ring of Edict purges all lurking in the shadows, as the greatsword vanishes back into darkness.

1077022.Name: Unfallen Bastion
1077022.Description: Unlocks the Unfallen Bastion skill effect.
1077022.Description2: A shield woven of black light stands unbroken, anchored at your side like an unassailable bastion.

1077023.Name: Soul Rock
1077023.Description: Unlocks the Soul Rock skill effect.
1077023.Description2: Music becomes medicine: rock anthems thunder through the sky, bolstering allies and casting away their wounds.

1077024.Name: Unchained Sound
1077024.Description: Unlocks the Unchained Sound skill effect.
1077024.Description2: Strings ignite forbidden notes, a black tide swells as feathers dance along the rhythm, witnessing a song no world dares forget.

1077025.Name: Skyward Sparks - Instant Edge Blossom
1077025.Description: Unlocks the Skyward Sparks - Instant Edge Blossom skill effect.
1077025.Description2:
Skyward Sparks: A flurry of slashes is unleashed. Arcs of light spiral outward, scattering cherry blossoms across the sky—as intense and as fleeting as fireworks.
Instant Edge Blossom: In a moment of slightly restrained sharpness, the Dual Axes swing down abruptly. Cherry blossoms bloom along their path, unfurling into a skyward sea of flowers before scattering with the wind in a flash.

1077026.Name: Wrath Into the Void
1077026.Description: Unlocks the Wrath Into the Void skill effect.
1077026.Description2: Wrath transforms into an endless barrage of cleaves. Axe blades carve through the air as light and shadow intertwine; void-rending blade echoes coil around the wielder, nearly consuming all. When the decisive strike lands, heaven and earth fall silent, and all wrath converges into a single blade.

1077027.Name: All-Ending Oblivion
1077027.Description: Unlocks the All-Ending Oblivion skill effect.
1077027.Description2: Wrath surges to its limit, the body becoming a raging tide that devours all. The blade incarnate—everything shatters in its wake. All clamor is silenced within this frenzied dance that rends the void, fading into oblivion.

1077028.Name: Clear Flow
1077028.Description: Unlocks the Clear Flow skill effect.
1077028.Description2: A single swing of the blade produces countless slashes of light. As the strikes unfold, the power of ancient remnants flows like swift clouds, weaving into an unbroken stream of platinum blade shadows. Slaughter is not the swordsman's intent, but rather a reflection of a clear will.

1077029.Name: Formless Flow
1077029.Description: Unlocks the Formless Flow skill effect.
1077029.Description2: When the swordsman's mind aligns with the sword, the blade is no longer bound by form—it can be an edge, a spike, or a scythe. Platinum power permeates the sharp edge, ensuring that even the most stubborn defense will be broken by the slash.

1077030.Name: Vortex Summoning Stance
1077030.Description: Unlocks the Vortex Summoning Stance skill effect.
1077030.Description2: Platinum light suddenly bursts forth, and a vortex ring engraved with ancient remnants quietly takes shape. Water energy is drawn in from all directions, as though a preexisting technique has been reawakened.

1077031.Name: Frozen Glint Stance
1077031.Description: Unlocks the Frozen Glint Stance skill effect.
1077031.Description2: By drawing on the power of platinum remnants, the chill is condensed to its limit before being unleashed in a crushing surge. A storm suddenly bursts forth, with ice and wind overlapping and swirling. Everything within reach is brought to a standstill.

1077032.Name: Resurrection
1077032.Description2: As chaotic vitality awakens a healing resonance, the power of platinum remnants intertwines and condenses. It transforms into the palpitation of all things reborn, soothing all pain.

1077033.Name: Breath of Revival
1077033.Description: Unlocks the Breath of Revival skill effect.
1077033.Description2: Overlooking the decay from above, the obsession known as healing is turned into a prayer. The power of ancient remnants swirls and surges, and this wish, born from the thirst for continuation, will ultimately bloom into the breath of revival.

1077034.Name: Mountain-Crushing Dash
1077034.Description: Unlocks the Mountain-Crushing Dash skill effect.
1077034.Description2: The platinum remnants manifest as the Guard Blade surges forward like a shifting mountain. This strike eliminates any room for retreat, crushing forward with an unshakable momentum.

1077035.Name: Bloodthirst Realm Protector
1077035.Description: Unlocks the Bloodthirst Realm Protector skill effect.
1077035.Description2: The suppressed battle intent bursts forth, and its momentum surges like waves. Wherever the platinum remnant emerges, all dust and stone congeal, transforming into a protective boundary.

1077036.Name: Void-Shattering Storm
1077036.Description: Unlocks the Void-Shattering Storm skill effect.
1077036.Description2: Flowing mist gathers at the tip of the spear, allowing the platinum power to resonate to its limit. The bindings are then released, unleashing a spiral capable of shredding space itself.

1077037.Name: Where the Gale Blows
1077037.Description: Unlocks the Where the Gale Blows skill effect.
1077037.Description2: All skill is poured into the spear point during the ride of the wind into the air. Platinum remnants flash. Where the gale blows is where destiny meets its end.

1077038.Name: Storm of Light Arrows
1077038.Description: Unlocks the Storm of Light Arrows skill effect.
1077038.Description2: The shadow of the arrow splits into countless platinum afterglows in mid-air, accompanied by the emergence of ancient remnants. In the next instant, light arrows descend like a torrential downpour.

1077039.Name: World-Piercing Arrow
1077039.Description: Unlocks the World-Piercing Arrow skill effect.
1077039.Description2: The fingertips act before the mind, and the arrowhead leaves the string in a fleeting moment. A light arrow, reflecting the glow of remnants, tears through the air, reducing all obstacles to dust.

1077040.Name: Conviction Loop
1077040.Description: Unlocks the Conviction Loop skill effect.
1077040.Description2: Protective conviction is gathered and released in a spinning throw. The platinum remnants continue to whirl, forming a wall of light shields. Wherever its radiance reaches, evil is held at bay.

1077041.Name: Oath Judgment
1077041.Description: Unlocks the Oath Judgment skill effect.
1077041.Description2: The blade is raised high, and the vow echoes loudly. The undying conviction is manifested through the power of ancient remnants. It serves both as a sharp blade to pierce through illusions and an unbreakable shield for steadfast defense.

1077042.Name: Gravity's Power Chord
1077042.Description: Unlocks the Gravity's Power Chord skill effect.
1077042.Description2: This is the moment—the beat in the mind has already taken over the motor nerves. In the face of this soundwave, even breathing out of rhythm is a transgression! Go on, press all those off-beat emotions straight into the strings... LISTEN UP, YOU PUNKS! This is a power chord straight from the pull of gravity!

1077043.Name: Restless Sweep
1077043.Description: Unlocks the Restless Sweep skill effect.
1077043.Description2: Does quietness signify maturity? No, it means the party's over... and I absolutely refuse to let that happen. Put away those soft little tunes and get back to the noise! In the melody of the platinum wave—NO! ONE! EVER! STOPS!

1077044.Name: Funereal Cocoon
1077044.Description: Unlocks the Funereal Cocoon skill effect.
1077044.Description2: With the body as the axis, long-accumulated power of severance is unleashed. The platinum arcs blooming from the Dual Axes weave a funereal cocoon around nearby enemies.

1077045.Name: Wail of Severance
1077045.Description: Unlocks the Wail of Severance skill effect.
1077045.Description2: The power of severance is pushed to its absolute limit, and the Dual Axes are crossed in a sweeping strike that releases a death-knell wail. Where the platinum scars burst open, the power of ancient remnants is fully revealed, cutting off all paths of retreat.

1080000.Name: Burning Powder
1080000.Description: A material that needs to be added during Forging .
1080000.Description2: With its skill to significantly elevate temperature, this carbon powder ensures deeper and more efficient processing during smelting.

1080001.Name: Metal Dust
1080001.Description: Metal dust refined through Forging techniques.
1080001.Description2: Fine and uniform, it may have residual heat to be utilized elsewhere.

1080002.Name: Metal Ingot
1080002.Description: Metal ingot meticulously crafted through Forging techniques.
1080002.Description2: Sturdy and durable, an important raw material for further processing and manufacturing high-quality metal products.

1080003.Name: Fast Burning Powder
1080003.Description: A material that needs to be added during Forging .
1080003.Description2: With its skill to significantly elevate temperature, this carbon powder ensures deeper and more efficient processing during smelting than standard one.

1080004.Name: Osteo Powder
1080004.Description2: Made from simply burned common wood, it ignites quickly and is suitable for daily cooking and heating.

1080005.Name: Fast-Burn Osteo Powder
1080005.Description2: Meticulously refined to have a higher ignition point and a longer burn time, this is a staple among artisans.

1080006.Name: Stormbreath Stardust
1080006.Description: A material that needs to be added during Forging .
1080006.Description2: Upon instant vaporization, it produces an iridescent whirlwind that causes the furnace temperature to surge to a critical point, enabling an ultra-pure combustion unattainable with ordinary fuel. A staple material for artisans.

1080011.Name: Baru Ore
1080011.Description: Can be converted into Mystery Metal for refining gear parts after Forging .
1080011.Description2: A basic ore with a black shiny luster. It has a relatively hard texture, a slightly rough surface, and irregular patterns.

1080012.Name: Baru Rich Ore
1080012.Description: Can be converted into a larger amount of Mystery Metal for refining gear parts after Forging .
1080012.Description2:
A basic ore with a black shiny luster. It has a relatively hard texture, a slightly rough surface, and irregular patterns.
Rich ores usually appear in clusters, containing much more mineral content than ordinary ores, but are less abundant and naturally more expensive.

1080013.Name: Baru Pure Ore
1080013.Description: Can be converted into an even larger amount of Mystery Metal for refining gear parts after Forging .
1080013.Description2:
A basic ore with a black shiny luster. It has a relatively hard texture, a slightly rough surface, and irregular patterns.
High-precision ores usually appear in areas with high Engram concentration, with some refined ores showing crystallization, containing much more mineral content than ordinary ores, and are very rare.

1080021.Name: Azte Ore
1080021.Description: After smelting, it can be converted into Radiant Stones used for Refine.
1080021.Description2: This ore is dark gray with a yellowish tint and a dim luster. The texture of the ore is relatively uniform, with no obvious flaws. Its moderate hardness makes it easy to cut and polish, which is precisely its charm.

1080022.Name: Azte Rich Ore
1080022.Description: After smelting, it can be converted into a larger quantity of Radiant Stones used for Refine.
1080022.Description2:
This ore is dark gray with a yellowish tint and a dim luster. The texture of the ore is relatively uniform, with no obvious flaws. Its moderate hardness makes it easy to cut and polish, which is precisely its charm.
Rich ores usually appear in clusters and have a much higher mineral content than ordinary raw stones, but their yield is lower, making them naturally more expensive.

1080023.Name: Azte Pure Ore
1080023.Description: After smelting, it can be converted into an even larger quantity of Radiant Stones used for Refine.
1080023.Description2:
This ore is dark gray with a yellowish tint and a dim luster. The texture of the ore is relatively uniform, with no obvious flaws. Its moderate hardness makes it easy to cut and polish, which is precisely its charm.
High-precision ores usually appear in areas with high Engram concentration. Some refined ores will crystallize, having a much higher content than ordinary raw stones, making them very rare.

1080031.Name: Luna Ore
1080031.Description: After smelting, it can be converted into Fine Forgestones used for Refine.
1080031.Description2: The surface shimmers with a soft and unique luster. When the light changes, this luster dances along, as if there is a mysterious power flowing inside the ore.

1080032.Name: Luna Rich Ore

1080041.Name: Stokes Ore
1080041.Description: After Forging , it can be converted into a special metal "Buri Mech Shard," which is used to increase the success rate of Refine.
1080041.Description2: It presents a unique luster, uniform and bright. Interestingly, a single ore sometimes contains multiple metal components. With advanced technology, it can be processed into a rare material.

1080042.Name: Stokes Rich Ore
1080042.Description: After Forging , it can be converted into a larger quantity of special metal "Buri Mech Shard," which is used to increase the success rate of Refine.
1080042.Description2:
It presents a unique luster, uniform and bright. Interestingly, a single ore sometimes contains multiple metal components. With advanced technology, it can be processed into a rare material.
Rich ores usually appear in clusters, with a higher mineral content than ordinary ores, but the yield is lower, and the price is naturally higher.

1080043.Name: Stokes Pure Ore
1080043.Description: After Forging , it can be converted into an even larger quantity of special metal "Buri Mech Shard," which is used to increase the success rate of Refine.
1080043.Description2:

1080044.Name: Runye Ore
1080044.Description: Can be forged into a large quantity of Mystery Metal, which is used for gear refinement.
1080044.Description2:
An ore native to the Bahamar Highlands. Its once-smooth surface is now coarse and covered in winding patterns and pores.
Under the influence of the Xeno Engram, it has become an entirely different mineral from Baru Ore.

1080125.Description2: While processing ores infused with Xeno Engram, artisans discovered two revolutionary reactions. One such reaction, "Isotopic," affirms the base material. It "recognizes" and "strengthens" the material's very essence, forging a reshaped alloy that is not only stronger but also possesses a degree of shape memory.

1080126.Description: A product of Smelting, mostly used to craft gear.

The creation of Heterotopic Alloy, akin to an artisan giving form to ever-shifting lightning, is enough to revolutionize existing crafting structures.

1101205.Description:
Open the path to hidden areas in Slumberdream Valley (Easy).
Exclusive to "Slumberdream Valley (Easy)". Single-use only. Path closes upon exiting the Illusion.
1101205.Description2: This key can unlock the sealed-off corners of one's mind.

1101206.Name: Mindscape Key II
1101206.Description:
Open the path to hidden areas in Slumberdream Valley (Hard).

1101207.Name: Mindscape Key III
1101207.Description:
Open the path to hidden areas in Slumberdream Valley (Nightmare).

1101207.Description2: This key can unlock the sealed-off corners of one's mind.

1101208.Name: Energizing Incense
1101208.Description:
Upon use, slightly reduces accumulated Slumberdream Value in the Slumberdream Valley.
Can only be used in the Slumberdream Valley, with a 300-second CD after usage.
1101208.Description2: An incense stick pressed from a mix of low-quality resin and cheap herbs. The smoke is pungent and irritates the throat, but it can just barely dispel the most superficial illusions. Adventurers new to the valley often pin it to their collars—despite the fact that long-term inhalation will damage their lungs.

1101209.Name: Mistmoon Incense
1101209.Description:
Upon use, reduces a certain amount of accumulated Slumberdream Value in the Slumberdream Valley.
Can only be used in the Slumberdream Valley, with a 300-second CD after usage.
1101209.Description2: Made from a plant unique to the Slumberdream Valley, it emits a cold, faint blue light when burned. Its fragrance freezes the cloudiness within the mind, but it also reveals the user's location—dream monsters despise its scent of "clarity."

1101210.Name: Cleansing Incense
1101210.Description:
Upon use, greatly reduces accumulated Slumberdream Value in the Slumberdream Valley.
Can only be used in the Slumberdream Valley, with a 300-second CD after usage.
1101210.Description2: Legend says it is refined from the remains of creatures in the valley. The silvery-white powder burns without a sound. It can completely incinerate dreams and even temporarily bend the rules—but each use seems to chip away a piece of the user's soul.

1101211.Name: Vision Imprint
1101211.Description:

Can only be used in the Illusion-Shroud Woods.

1101212.Name: Mind-Soothing Elixir - Luminescence
1101212.Description:
Upon use, slightly slows Illusion-Shroud Value accumulation in the Illusion-Shroud Woods.
Can only be used in the Illusion-Shroud Woods.
1101212.Description2: A pristine drop of morning dew that suppresses the maddening whispers at your ears, allowing your consciousness to barely surface within the Illusion-Shroud Woods.

1101213.Name: Mind-Soothing Elixir - Radiance
1101213.Description:
Upon use, slows Illusion-Shroud Value accumulation in the Illusion-Shroud Woods to some extent.
Can only be used in the Illusion-Shroud Woods.
1101213.Description2: A golden drop of dew wreathed in an ethereal mist. It forms a barrier within the mind that firmly resists the erosion of hallucinations.

1101214.Name: Mind-Soothing Elixir - Brilliance
1101214.Description:
Upon use, significantly slows Illusion-Shroud Value accumulation in the Illusion-Shroud Woods.
Can only be used in the Illusion-Shroud Woods.
1101214.Description2: A dreamlike dew, where ethereal mist condenses into a purification aura. It grants instant insight into the essence of dreams, bringing absolute clarity of mind.

1101217.Description:

1101217.Description2: This key can unlock the sealed-off corners of one's mind.

1101218.Name: Phase Lens - Luminescence
1101218.Description:
Upon use, slightly reduces accumulated Illusion-Shroud Value in the Illusion-Shroud Woods.
Can only be used in the Illusion-Shroud Woods. A 300-second CD will apply after using the lens.
1101218.Description2: A razor-thin silver-white lens set within a rusted iron frame. Held before the eye, it barely allows one to see through the disguises of lesser phantom beasts in the Illusion-Shroud Woods—the reflection strips away a layer of illusion. Yet, a biting, bone-deep chill seeps from its surface; stare too long, and fine ice crystals will form across your very eyes.

1101219.Name: Phase Lens - Radiance
1101219.Description:
Upon use, reduces a certain amount of accumulated Illusion-Shroud Value in the Illusion-Shroud Woods.
Can only be used in the Illusion-Shroud Woods. A 300-second CD will apply after using the lens.
1101219.Description2: A circular lens forged from pure gold, its frame carved with twisted runes. It can tear through intermediate phase barriers, hidden paths, and traps within the dreamscape. But this gold exacts a toll, draining the warmth from its wielder. With every focused gaze, the fingertips grow stiffer, until the entire hand solidifies into a freezing, lifeless sculpture.

1101220.Name: Phase Lens - Brilliance
1101220.Description:
Upon use, greatly reduces accumulated Illusion-Shroud Value in the Illusion-Shroud Woods.
Can only be used in the Illusion-Shroud Woods. A 300-second CD will apply after using the lens.
1101220.Description2: Backed in gold, the lens's surface flows with ever-shifting stardust and iridescent light. It does not merely pierce illusions; it forcibly "reads" the deepest rules of the dreamscape within the Illusion-Shroud Woods, briefly rewriting the local phase flows. Yet, with every use, the lens reflects the wielder's most terrifying memories, quietly weaving them into the next dream—until they can no longer tell if they are observing the dreamscape, or imprisoned within it.

2000617.Name: Shadow of the Far Sea
2000617.Description: An epic weapon for the Stormblade class. It can be upgraded to higher levels using a few Glinting Stellar Cores as this season progresses.\nAfter upgrading to item level 180, it can be crafted at Lunel, an NPC of the Artisan Guild, into an "Ember - Far Sea" weapon at item level 220, which also activates the weapon's visual effects.\nThe gear Modification feature can be used to select up to 4 entry effects for "Ember - Far Sea" weapons.
2000617.Description2:
"In the dark of night, tides surge like a silent blade slicing through the deep.
Lightning cleaves the waves, leaving behind traces that vanish in an instant.
The scythe dances with the wind. What it reaps is not just mortal bodies, but the rifts of fate.
Each strike is a judgment jointly issued by the sea and storm.
And the echo that remains is but solemn silence within shattered tides."
(Excerpt from "Book of the Depths VII")

2000618.Name: Revelation of the Far Sea
2000618.Description: An epic weapon for the Frost Mage class. It can be upgraded to higher levels using a few Glinting Stellar Cores as this season progresses.\nAfter upgrading to item level 180, it can be crafted at Lunel, an NPC of the Artisan Guild, into an "Ember - Far Sea" weapon at item level 220, which also activates the weapon's visual effects.\nThe gear Modification feature can be used to select up to 4 entry effects for "Ember - Far Sea" weapons.
2000618.Description2:
"Between the sea's breaths lies an untold truth.
It carves verses into the surging waves, writing them upon moonlit waters.
The tip of the staff catches a fleeting ripple, turning it into light.
Light pierces the mist, reaching even the deepest longing.
If you're willing to listen, the sea will offer you its answer."
(Excerpt from "Book of the Depths II")

2000619.Name: Wish of the Far Sea
2000619.Description: An epic weapon for the Wind Knight class. It can be upgraded to higher levels using a few Glinting Stellar Cores as this season progresses.\nAfter upgrading to item level 180, it can be crafted at Lunel, an NPC of the Artisan Guild, into an "Ember - Far Sea" weapon at item level 220, which also activates the weapon's visual effects.\nThe gear Modification feature can be used to select up to 4 entry effects for "Ember - Far Sea" weapons.
2000619.Description2:
"Its edge points straight into the distance, like tides rushing toward the endless sky.
It holds the sea's whispers, engraving vows between wind and water.
Every thrust is for the sake of protection, turning gales into unwavering creed.
And the knight's wish shall echo with the tide, reaching the farthest shore."
(Excerpt from "Book of the Depths VIII")

2000620.Name: Grace of the Far Sea
2000620.Description: An epic weapon for the Verdant Oracle class. It can be upgraded to higher levels using a few Glinting Stellar Cores as this season progresses.\nAfter upgrading to item level 180, it can be crafted at Lunel, an NPC of the Artisan Guild, into an "Ember - Far Sea" weapon at item level 220, which also activates the weapon's visual effects.\nThe gear Modification feature can be used to select up to 4 entry effects for "Ember - Far Sea" weapons.
2000620.Description2:
"In the realm of ebbing tides, the sea leaves behind its final sigh.
The shattered reflections of starlight float on the water, like dreams yet unbroken.
Listen! Each rising tide is the heartbeat of a gentle and solemn deity.
The light surging through the ring soothes bloodstains, granting peace to weary souls."
(Excerpt from "Book of the Depths I")

2000621.Name: Waiting of the Far Sea
2000621.Description: An epic weapon for the Heavy Guardian class. It can be upgraded to higher levels using a few Glinting Stellar Cores as this season progresses.\nAfter upgrading to item level 180, it can be crafted at Lunel, an NPC of the Artisan Guild, into an "Ember - Far Sea" weapon at item level 220, which also activates the weapon's visual effects.\nThe gear Modification feature can be used to select up to 4 entry effects for "Ember - Far Sea" weapons.
2000621.Description2:
"The tide is not only gentle; it can become a stern barrier.
Great waves lie prostrate before the reefs, safeguarding the silence behind.
The blade's edge is like the spine of the earth, firm and unyielding.
Each impact echoes the ceaseless song of the ocean.
Guardian, the faith of the deep sea has long been bound to your soul."
(Excerpt from "Book of the Depths III")

2000622.Name: Gaze of the Far Sea
2000622.Description: An epic weapon for the Marksman class. It can be upgraded to higher levels using a few Glinting Stellar Cores as this season progresses.\nAfter upgrading to item level 180, it can be crafted at Lunel, an NPC of the Artisan Guild, into an "Ember - Far Sea" weapon at item level 220, which also activates the weapon's visual effects.\nThe gear Modification feature can be used to select up to 4 entry effects for "Ember - Far Sea" weapons.
2000622.Description2:
"The sea's gaze reaches farther than the wind, longer than the waves.
The bowstring draws tight, as if binding the skyline tightly.
The arrow carry the breath of the tide, crossing the boundary of water and sky.
It always finds its destination, reaching where the heart yearns."
(Excerpt from "Book of the Depths IV")

2000623.Name: Vow of the Far Sea
2000623.Description: An epic weapon for the Shield Knight class. It can be upgraded to higher levels using a few Glinting Stellar Cores as this season progresses.\nAfter upgrading to item level 180, it can be crafted at Lunel, an NPC of the Artisan Guild, into an "Ember - Far Sea" weapon at item level 220, which also activates the weapon's visual effects.\nThe gear Modification feature can be used to select up to 4 entry effects for "Ember - Far Sea" weapons.
2000623.Description2:
"Withdraw, withdraw, yet there always remain the unyielding reefs.
That is the ocean's silent vow, standing firmly on the shore forever.
The shield bears the waves, embracing the surge without resistance.
With every impact, it endures alongside the sea, without end.
It grants peace to the soul, so the brave may walk without fear.
In the eternal sound of the tide, protection becomes an endless poem."
(Excerpt from "Book of the Depths V")

2000624.Name: Hymn of the Far Sea
2000624.Description:
An epic weapon for the Beat Performer. It can be upgraded
to higher levels using a few Glinting Stellar Cores as this season progresses.\nAfter upgrading to item level 180, it can be crafted at Lunel, an NPC of the Artisan Guild, into an "Ember - Far Sea" weapon at item level 220, which also activates the weapon's visual effects.\nThe gear Modification feature can be used to select up to 4 entry effects for "Ember - Far Sea" weapons.
2000624.Description2:
"Waves strike the reef like trembling strings.
Their sound rises from the surge, chasing the wind into the boundless sky.
Each chord is a secret the deep sea has yet to speak.
Stars and waterlight resonate, weaving a melody that surrounds the battlefield.
And those who listen shall find their way home within the hymn."
(Excerpt from "Book of the Depths VI")

2000625.Name: Fury of the Far Sea
2000625.Description: An epic Twin Striker weapon.It can be upgraded to higher levels using a few Glinting Stellar Cores as this season progresses.\nAfter breaking through to item level 180, it can be crafted at Lunel, an NPC of the Artisan Guild, into an "Ember - Far Sea" weapon at item level 220, which also activates the weapon's visual effects.\nThe gear Modification feature can be used to select up to 4 entry effects for "Ember - Far Sea" weapons.
2000625.Description2:
"When the tides converge within the abyss, they cleave through chaos, forging a fearless heart into the surging waves.
A vow of resolve is cast into the boundless depths.
Within that ceaseless tempest, only an unyielding soul may endure the deep sea's eternal solitude."
(Excerpt from "Book of the Depths IX")

3000001.Name: Battle Imagine - Void Ogre
3000001.Description:
Activates or advances Void Ogre's Battle Imagine skill: Stunt! Chaotic Barrage.

Stunt! Chaotic Barrage
Summons Elite: Void Ogre to roar in place, and fire 6 whirlwind-like Void Projectiles at the target, dealing Attack DMG. Inflicts Void Corruption Decay on the target for 10s, dealing Magic DMG per second, up to 5 stacks. 100% of the DMG dealt over time is converted into your HP.
3000001.Description2: A crystallization of thoughts, consciousness, and Engram, possessing supernatural power. This principle has not been unraveled since the Bapharian civilization.

3000002.Name: Battle Imagine - Muku Warrior
3000002.Description:
Activates or advances the Battle Imagine skill of Muku Warrior - Stunt! Super Critical.

Stunt! Super Critical
Resonates with the power of Elite Muku Warrior, leaps forward to launch a powerful attack, dealing area Attack DMG. This attack is guaranteed to deliver Crit DMG, and increases your Crit rate and Crit DMG bonus for 20s.
3000002.Description2: A crystallization of thoughts, consciousness, and Engram, possessing supernatural power. This principle has not been unraveled since the Bapharian civilization.

3000003.Name: Battle Imagine - Inferno Goblin Mage
3000003.Description:
Activates or advances Inferno Goblin Mage's Battle Imagine skill: Stunt! Falling Star.

Stunt! Falling Star
Transforms into Elite: Inferno Goblin Mage and summons meteors from the sky, dealing Magic DMG.
Upon the skill cast, your Intellect is increased for a period.
3000003.Description2: A crystallization of thoughts, consciousness, and Engram, possessing supernatural power. This principle has not been unraveled since the Bapharian civilization.

3000004.Name: Battle Imagine - Shadow Captain
3000004.Description:
Activates or advances Shadow Captain's Battle Imagine skill: Stunt! Electro Bomb.

Stunt! Electro Bomb
Transforms into Elite: Shadow Captain and fires an Electro Bomb at the target, causing AoE Attack DMG and silencing the target.
Upon the skill cast, the DMG dealt and healing of your Expertise Skill are increased for a period.
3000004.Description2: A crystallization of thoughts, consciousness, and Engram, possessing supernatural power. This principle has not been unraveled since the Bapharian civilization.

3000005.Name: Battle Imagine - Void Foxen
3000005.Description:
Activates or advances the Battle Imagine skill of Mutant Foxen - Stunt! Spirit Fox Assault.

Stunt! Spirit Fox Assault
Resonates with the power of Elite Mutant Foxen, leaps into the air and swiftly pounces forward for a rapid kill, dealing area Attack DMG, and increases your haste bonus for 20s.
3000005.Description2: A crystallization of thoughts, consciousness, and Engram, possessing supernatural power. This principle has not been unraveled since the Bapharian civilization.

3000006.Name: Battle Imagine - Boarrier Tyrant
3000006.Description:

5160007.Description: Obtain a random advanced or higher quality module.

5160008.Name: Special Grant from the Pioneer Bureau
5160008.Description: A Module​ Box that drops additionally from the Boss Loot Chest during the period from 05:00 on Nov. 17, 2025 to 05:00 on Dec. 1, 2025. Upon opening, you will randomly obtain one Excellent Module​.
5160008.Description2:
Upon witnessing your relentless efforts, Miss Valeria submitted a special request to the Pioneer Bureau on your behalf.
"Adventurer, consider this gift a token of my gratitude!"

5500101.Description2: Modules are precision technological devices that adventurers can equip to enhance their strength by linking to the module's power core. This basic Attack Module has good performance and contains only 1 power core.

5500102.Name: Advanced Attack Module
5500102.Description2: Modules are precision technological devices that adventurers can equip to enhance their strength by linking to the module's power core. This Advanced Attack Module has excellent performance, operates flexibly, and contains 2 power cores, making it popular among adventurers.

5500103.Name: Excellent Attack Module
5500103.Description2: Modules are precision technological devices that adventurers can equip to enhance their strength by linking to the module's power core. This superior Attack Module has outstanding performance, contains 3 power cores, and is very rare, making it highly sought after by many adventurers.

7015137.Name: Spring Dawn
7015137.Description: You can go to the wardrobe to mix and match, becoming the most dazzling adventurer!
7015137.Description2:
Feathered blossoms scatter through the jade-bright night, as the cold bites, the moon wanes and rounds. Beyond the curtain, the east wind blows, then falls still again. Fish-and-dragon lantern dances unfold, silks and finery layer upon layer, all signs of a festival in peaceful times.
Pepper-blossom and cypress wine flush the cheeks with red, as old peachwood charms are torn away for new. Who would believe the withered branches already brim with urgent spring? One crisp, sudden sound fills half the window with crimson glow, shaking loose the snow from the treetop tips.

7115137.Name: Spring Dawn
7115137.Description: You can go to the wardrobe to mix and match, becoming the most dazzling adventurer!
7115137.Description2:
Feathered blossoms scatter through the jade-bright night, as the cold bites, the moon wanes and rounds. Beyond the curtain, the east wind blows, then falls still again. Fish-and-dragon lantern dances unfold, silks and finery layer upon layer, all signs of a festival in peaceful times.
Pepper-blossom and cypress wine flush the cheeks with red, as old peachwood charms are torn away for new. Who would believe the withered branches already brim with urgent spring? One crisp, sudden sound fills half the window with crimson glow, shaking loose the snow from the treetop tips.

7125137.Name: Spring Dawn
7125137.Description: You can go to the wardrobe to mix and match, becoming the most dazzling adventurer!
7125137.Description2:
Feathered blossoms scatter through the jade-bright night, as the cold bites, the moon wanes and rounds. Beyond the curtain, the east wind blows, then falls still again. Fish-and-dragon lantern dances unfold, silks and finery layer upon layer, all signs of a festival in peaceful times.
Pepper-blossom and cypress wine flush the cheeks with red, as old peachwood charms are torn away for new. Who would believe the withered branches already brim with urgent spring? One crisp, sudden sound fills half the window with crimson glow, shaking loose the snow from the treetop tips.

7310001.Description2: In the hazy midnight, the clouds grow dim... The weapon nurtures intention, yet its message remains obscure!

7310002.Name: Mirrorlight Blade
7310002.Description: After equipping, the weapon's appearance will be replaced with: Mirrorlight Blade (exclusive to the Stormblade class).
7310002.Description2: Its surface gleams, bright enough to mirror one's reflection. Its edge is keen, able to sever a strand of hair. Its strike is inescapable, cutting through like flowing light!

7310003.Name: Twilight Wish Knife
7310003.Description: When equipped, the weapon's appearance will be replaced with: Twilight Wish Blade (exclusive to the Stormblade class).
7310003.Description2: A weapon forged from the fading warmth of light, burning with the last memories of sunset.

7310004.Name: Sakura Blade
7310004.Description: After equipping, the weapon's appearance will be replaced with: Sakura Blade (exclusive to the Stormblade class).
7310004.Description2: In life, be as splendid as cherry blossoms dancing in the wind. In death, be as silent as fallen leaves returning to its roots!

7310005.Name: Doomlord Blade
7310005.Description: When equipped, the weapon's appearance will change to: Doomlord Blade (exclusive to the Stormblade class).
7310005.Description2: Shaped like lightning, sharp and unstoppable! Its bearer must remember, only with an indomitable spirit can one truly move forward!

7310006.Name: Shadow of the Far Sea
7310006.Description: When equipped, the weapon's appearance will be replaced with: Shadow of the Far Sea (exclusive to the Stormblade class).
7310006.Description2:
"In the dark of night, tides surge like a silent blade slicing through the deep.
Lightning cleaves the waves, leaving behind traces that vanish in an instant.
The scythe dances with the wind. What it reaps is not just mortal bodies, but the rifts of fate.
Each strike is a judgment jointly issued by the sea and storm.
And the echo that remains is but solemn silence within shattered tides."
(Excerpt from "Book of the Depths VII")

7310007.Description2: Forged with radiant ember, the blade surges with unstoppable force.

7310008.Name: Gilded Promise Blade

7310008.Description2: It witnessed a knight's whispered vow and guarded a nameless love in the night. Adorned with roses—like morning stars kissing fresh snow, or an oath sinking into immortal dawn—it offers every swing to a spring yet to come.

9040062.Name: Core Drive
9040062.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040062.Description2: Inspired by prototype armor developed at the Valando Research Institute. It doesn't override your will, but amplifies your resolve. Once equipped, hesitation fades into silence. Only the step you must take remains.

9040063.Name: Awakened Drive
9040063.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040063.Description2: Battle will fully activated. Core Drive sealed within deep protocols released. The armor reconstructs itself through high-energy resonance. With all primal constraints lifted, a surge of extraordinary perception and power floods into every nerve of the wearer. In this moment, you are no longer the controller, but the will of the Core Drive itself.

9040064.Name: Xeno Mimic
9040064.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040064.Description2:
"Data sync complete. Mimetic Core linked."
A mysterious armor from an uncharted astral realm. Its surface, woven from bioadaptive metal, reshapes itself, becoming a second heart to its wearer. In this moment, you become the will of a star, igniting the light that turns fate on its head.

9040065.Name: Disorder Mimic
9040065.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040065.Description2:
"Warning: Core malfunction. Void sequence initiated."
What's been corrupted is not only the Mimetic Core, but also the once-unyielding battle will. The armor has fallen into disorder, its radiance twisted, its reason shattered. Now, it protects no one. It roars only for destruction.

9040066.Name: Hyper Impulse
9040066.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040066.Description2: A drive mount specifically crafted for prototype armor, equipped with multidimensional sensors and a dynamic stabilization core. The moment the engine ignites, all restraints are left behind.

9040067.Name: Firestorm Impulse
9040067.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040067.Description2: Leap into the unknown. Heatwaves, blazing flames, and thunderous echoes-everything teeters on the edge of eruption. Accelerate, and accelerate, until you become a shadow the wind cannot catch.

9040068.Name: Golem Foxen
9040068.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040068.Description2: Its every move is swift and precise, almost primal. Born from a flawless system, this beast needs no roar to inspire fear; its silence alone is terrifying.

9040069.Name: Abyss Foxen
9040069.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040069.Description2: Its contours are honed to the extreme, every inch of its structure built for speed. And that flash of red in its eyes? The final signal before it moves.

9040070.Name: Starry Night
9040070.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040070.Description2:
As night draws its curtain, starlight softly answers from above.
Every step and turn is a stroke upon the canvas of darkness, tracing paths meant only for the stage.
Tonight, the stars wink awake and dreams quietly make their entrance.

9040071.Name: Starry Dream
9040071.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040071.Description2:
The ball has ended, yet the starlight lingers.
The light slowly falls, unfolding a celebration of silence.
No audience, no applause, only dance steps that continue in the night: Arriving as promised, never ceasing.

9040072.Name: Reverie Rhapsody
9040072.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040072.Description2:
The dream never ends. It becomes a melody echoing deep within memory.
Each spin is an unwritten verse, cast in light and shadow upon the stage.
It's the rhythm of unspoken words, a song woven from forgotten wishes.

9040073.Name: Reverie Night
9040073.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040073.Description2:
The light no longer dazzles, yet it's all the more entrancing.
As night unfurls, notes and whispers intertwine, guiding each step deeper into dreamlike illusion.

9040074.Name: Twilight Stage
9040074.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040074.Description2:
The lights are on, the music is ready, and the stage is set. With or without an audience, the show will go on.
Because some songs are meant only for the night to hear.

9040075.Name: Dawnlight Stage
9040075.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040075.Description2:
From this moment, you are the focus on the stage.
Here, there are no rules. Only music, and absolute freedom.

9040076.Name: Devilray
9040076.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040076.Description2: A ripple rises at the edge of distant clouds. As it passes, the night grows warmer.

9040077.Name: Fleeting Devilray
9040077.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040077.Description2: It ascends before the morning sheds its gray, like a traveler arriving ahead of the dawn. In that brief shimmer, you'd swear the sky itself stirred awake.

9040078.Name: Moonrise
9040078.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040078.Description2:
At the bottom of the letter, a line of words is repeatedly scrawled:
"You'll come, right?"

9040079.Name: White Wolf's Seal
9040079.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040079.Description2:
Records say the White Wolf once appeared in ancient times and lived among the Wolf Totem tribe. With the White Wolf's blessing, the tribe triumphed in every battle and endured to this day.
This is not mere myth. Ancient Asterleeds texts also record multiple sightings of the Kanamia White Wolf. But the White Wolf is nowhere to be found in the present Kanamia Tribe... What happened in between?

9040080.Name: Elder Splasha's Seal
9040080.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040080.Description2:
Elder Splasha once oversaw the tribe's livestock. All the fish grew well under his care.
When it comes to confessions, however, the elder always sighed helplessly.
"Whenever someone does wrong, they come to me to confess. They all think I have a fish-like memory, which only lasts 7s. But they have no idea how clever fish truly are! They remember things perfectly from 7 months ago, maybe even 7 years ago!"

9040081.Name: Elder Voidmind's Seal
9040081.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040081.Description2:
Elder Voidmind was the guide of wisdom. He studied ancient scrolls and uncovered many ancestral truths. The Longevity Tree, used as the tribe's council hall, flourished under his care.
However, 7 years ago, Elder Voidmind vanished without a trace...
Rumor says he never truly left, but chose to hide among the tribe, observing the world through mortal eyes.

9040082.Name: Elder Mushroom's Seal
9040082.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040082.Description2:
Elder Mushroom once governed the tribe's lands and harvests. During a famine, she cultivated tree mushrooms to help the tribe through its hardest times, earning deep affection from all.

9040095.Description2: With a heart light as a feather and a swirl of colorful shadows, my light steps chase the spring sun with a smile. A meteor shower that cannot be concealed. The wind carries whispered wishes, one after another.

9040098.Description2: Hark, an absurd melody echoes in the depths of darkness. The puppets' wild laughter and the sound of tears, all echoes of my shattered heart. Come, fall into this phantasm with me, until the final curtain falls.

9040117.Name: Spring Dawn
9040117.Description: Used to personalize your Badge collection. Once obtained, you can display it in your Personal Space.
9040117.Description2:
Feathered blossoms scatter through the jade-bright night, as the cold bites, the moon wanes and rounds. Beyond the curtain, the east wind blows, then falls still again. Fish-and-dragon lantern dances unfold, silks and finery layer upon layer, all signs of a festival in peaceful times.
Pepper-blossom and cypress wine flush the cheeks with red, as old peachwood charms are torn away for new. Who would believe the withered branches already brim with urgent spring? One crisp, sudden sound fills half the window with crimson glow, shaking loose the snow from the treetop tips.

11010503.Name: Blazing Grill
11010503.Description: One bite might remind you of youthful days running under the sunset.

11010505.Name: Ill-tempered Barrel
11010505.Description: Don't mess with it. A single pat will spill water everywhere.

11010506.Name: Belated Gift
11010506.Description: A hope hung on the wall. Perhaps some careless fellow left it here—and over time, it began to glow on its own.

11010507.Name: Lost Warmth
11010507.Description: Just looking at it makes you feel the cold melt away.

11010508.Name: Red Surprise
11010508.Description: A lovely ribbon is wrapped proudly around it, outshining even the gift inside.

11010509.Name: Golden Thoughts
11010509.Description: It feels as though it holds a sentence that was never spoken aloud.

11010510.Name: White Wish
11010510.Description: If winter were to send you a letter, it would probably be folded just like this.

11010511.Name: Stacked Wishes I
11010511.Description: Layers of anticipation, set gently in place.

11010512.Name: Stacked Wishes II
11010512.Description: A few heartfelt wishes are gathering together, as if quietly trading secrets.

11010513.Name: First-Snow Tree
11010513.Description: Carrying the first blush of early winter, it waits for the celebration to begin.

11010514.Name: Aurora Tree
11010514.Description: With a grand stance, it lights up the end of the long night.

11010515.Name: Warm-Winter Tree
11010515.Description: Trimmed with just the right touch of red and gold, it glows quietly with holiday warmth.

11010517.Name: Blessed Ornament I
11010517.Description: The moment it's placed, you start celebrating earlier than anyone else.

11010518.Name: Blessed Ornament II
11010518.Description: Just by appearing, it instantly livens up the scene.

11010519.Name: Jiggly Snowflake
11010519.Description: Maybe it's afraid of heights. Once hung up, it kept trembling.

11010520.Name: Flawless Winter
11010520.Description: It gathers the quietude of winter.

11010521.Name: Snuggly Gingerbread Duo
11010521.Description: Wait... would anyone really have the heart to separate and eat them?

11010522.Name: Gingerbread Reindeer
11010522.Description: Sadly, it cannot pull a cart.

11011706.Name: Figurine - Malice Scales
11011706.Description: A figure modeled after the monster Malice Scales.

11010523.Name: Hanging Festivity - Red
11010523.Description: One of the two busiest colors of the festival, it revels in the spotlight's favor.

11010524.Name: Hanging Festivity - Green
11010524.Description: As the second of the festival's busiest colors, it's a bit more reserved than the other, yet still eye-catching.

11010525.Name: Winter Pal I
11010525.Description: It stands there quietly, as if listening to the snow drift down.

11010526.Name: Winter Pal II
11010526.Description: It may appear calm, but it's more excited about snow than anyone.

11010529.Name: Floating Snowflake III
11010529.Description: Step once and see if it startles first.

11010530.Name: Floating Snowflake IV
11010530.Description: Don't overthink. It awaits your next step even more eagerly than you.

11010531.Name: Floating Snowflake V
11010531.Description: Sometimes it wobbles, probably just saying hello.

11010532.Name: Floating Snowflake VI
11010532.Description: Good-tempered, never angry no matter how it's stepped on.

11010533.Name: Floating Snowflake VII
11010533.Description: If you jump lightly enough, it will stay quiet with you.

11010534.Name: Floating Snowflake VIII
11010534.Description: Perhaps a stair laid down from the sky.

11010535.Name: Floating Snowflake IX
11010535.Description: Waiting for someone's footsteps to awaken it.

11010542.Name: Spring Glow II
11010542.Description: A thousand gates await the arrival of spring.

11010543.Name: Inked Today I
11010543.Description: On paper, clouds and mist shape countless forms.

11010544.Name: Inked Today II
11010544.Description: In ink, sun and moon awaken a fresh breeze.

11010545.Description2: Joyful faces welcome the blessings of renewal.

11010546.Description: Renewal Festival–themed furniture, obtainable by exchanging rewards from the limited-time Renewal Light wish event.
11010546.Description2: Laughter and cheer bring blessings of renewal.

11010547.Name: Tidings of Spring
11010547.Description: The east wind brought good tidings in the night, and the garden's first branch has bloomed.

11010548.Name: Bright Candle
11010548.Description: A lone light casts its glow upon the window screen.

11010549.Name: Crimson Lantern
11010549.Description: Its delicate form glows in the depth of night.

11010550.Name: Spring Wind's Arrival
11010550.Description: As it opens and closes, the spring mountains emerge.

11010551.Name: Thousandfold Brocade
11010551.Description: Auspicious hues fill the sky, streaming through the window screens.

11010552.Name: Auspicious Clouds
11010552.Description: Cut from rosy clouds to adorn the new hall.

11010556.Name: Flowlight
11010556.Description: Let the fleeting years drift like glowing embers.

11010557.Name: Bag of Blessings
11010557.Description: A universe lies within the bag!

11010558.Name: Moonlit Fireworks
11010558.Description: Trees of fire and silver blooms light up the sky.

11010559.Name: Reflected Radiance
11010559.Description: Sharing fine moments and beautiful views together.

11010560.Name: Lantern Glow
11010560.Description: Smiles fill the Lantern Festival night, sharing the same bright moon.

11010561.Name: Lingering Spring
11010561.Description: Silver candlelight illuminates her crimson blush.

11010562.Name: Whispered Prayers

11010565.Description: This solitary branch awaits the spring breeze.

11010567.Name: Renewal's Call

11010567.Description2: Laughter and chatter fill the air, welcoming renewal.

11034001.Name: Regular Fishing Pole
11034001.Description:
A cheap but practical fishing pole, it is the entry-level rod for all fishing enthusiasts.
The fishing pole has durability, and fishing will consume the rod's durability. Once the durability is exhausted, the rod will be lost.
There is a certain probability of accidental damage while fishing, which will directly result in the loss of the rod.

11034002.Name: Sturdy Fishing Pole
11034002.Description:
A fishing pole made of stronger materials.
It has higher durability and can slightly increase the speed of reeling in fish after a bite.
The fishing pole has durability, and fishing will consume the rod's durability. Once the durability is exhausted, the rod will be lost.
This type of rod will not accidentally break while fishing.

11034003.Name: Flexible Fishing Pole
11034003.Description:
Made of more flexible materials, with improved durability.
Equipped with a more flexible fishing line, it can slow down the tension increase of the line while fishing.
The fishing pole has durability, and fishing will consume the rod's durability. Once the durability is exhausted, the rod will be lost.
There is a certain probability of accidental damage while fishing, which will directly result in the loss of the rod.
