12010001.Name: Boarlet
12010001.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010001.Description2: Despite its small appearance, it can reliably support the rider and has impressive speed that contradicts its short legs. It is a round-eyed cutie.

12010002.Name: Eaglefeather Steed
12010002.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010002.Description2: A large horse-type Mount Imagine. It has a solid build and can easily carry a fully armed adventurer without any effort. The riding experience of this type of Mount Imagine is comfortable and stable, and its jumping ability is exceptional compared to usual Mount Imagines.

12010003.Name: Recon Oculoid
12010003.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010003.Description2: A floating eye-type Mount Imagine. It floats in mid-air through magical power and moves incredibly smoothly. Contrary to what it may appear like, it is easy to maintain balance while riding, and once you get the hang of it, it becomes quite enjoyable to ride on.

12010004.Name: Royal Horse - Platinum
12010004.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010004.Description2: The representative of large horse-type Mount Imagines-the Royal Horse. It has a solid build and can easily carry a fully armed adventurer without any effort. The riding experience of this type of Mount Imagine is comfortable and stable, and its jumping ability is exceptional compared to usual Mount Imagines.

12010005.Name: Byrnhald Golem
12010005.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010005.Description2: A Mount Imagine made to resemble Byrnhald's giant machinery. For the rider's safety, its size has been appropriately reduced, but its power system remains undiminished. It can stably jump and land while also possessing strong arm strength.

12010006.Name: Loyal Boarlet
12010006.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010006.Description2: Who can resist a shiny, round-eyed cutie!

12010009.Description2: Its every move is swift and precise, almost primal. Born from a flawless system, this beast needs no roar to inspire fear; its silence alone is terrifying.

12010011.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010011.Description2: Bunny-shaped Mount Imagine. It is said to have gradually evolved through generations of effort. They not only perform well in snowy terrain but also become great companions for adventurers.

12010012.Name: Twilight Stage
12010012.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010012.Description2: The lights are up, the soundscape is in place, and the stage is all set. Whether there's an audience or not, the show will go on. After all, some songs are just for the night.

12010013.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010013.Description2: A Mount Imagine built around a special material that approximates low-altitude gliding in a mobile manner. Young people have created a variety of techniques to ride it elegantly. Its unique sense of speed is filled with unparalleled charm.

12010014.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010014.Description2: A broom-type Mount Imagine that continues the ancient tradition of "flying on it" while being transformed into a modern and stylish design. Its footrests help you maintain balance, and the cushion provides a more comfortable riding experience.

12010015.Description2: A Mount Imagine from a distant land, regarded as an authentic tradition and passed down to this day. It symbolizes good fortune, and it is said that if you are lucky enough to see it run or touch its face, you will have a healthy and smooth year ahead.

12010054.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010054.Description2: Leap into the unknown. Heatwaves, blazing flames, and thunderous echoes-everything teeters on the edge of eruption. Accelerate, and accelerate, until you become a shadow the wind cannot catch.

12010055.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010055.Description2: A ripple rises at the edge of distant clouds. As it passes, the night grows warmer.

12010056.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010056.Description2: It ascends before the morning sheds its gray, like a traveler arriving ahead of the dawn. In that brief shimmer, you'd swear the sky itself stirred awake.

12010058.Description2: A fantastical vehicle from another realm, it hovers effortlessly by mystical forces and glides with astonishing grace.

12010059.Name: Shadowplay Puppeteer
12010059.Description: A type of Mount Imagine. It offers not only a faster speed but also unique, exclusive skills for a completely different experience.
12010059.Description2: Beneath a curtain woven from shadows, I pull the strings of phantom souls. Should you gaze too long, you shall dance with me, until the applause fades into the silent night.

12010060.Name: Shadowplay Puppeteer - Lost
12010060.Description: A type of Mount Imagine. It offers not only a faster speed but also unique, exclusive skills for a completely different experience.
12010060.Description2: Hark, an absurd melody echoes in the depths of darkness. The puppets' wild laughter and the sound of tears, all echoes of my shattered heart. Come, fall into this phantasm with me, until the final curtain falls.

12010061.Name: Woven Radiance
12010061.Description: A type of Mount Imagine. It offers not only a faster speed but also unique, exclusive skills for a completely different experience.
12010061.Description2: With a heart light as a feather and a swirl of colorful shadows, my light steps chase the spring sun with a smile. A meteor shower that cannot be concealed. The wind carries whispered wishes, one after another.

12010062.Name: Woven Radiance - Reflection
12010062.Description: A type of Mount Imagine. It offers not only a faster speed but also unique, exclusive skills for a completely different experience.
12010062.Description2: A clear shadow falls silently upon still water, glimmering with faint, star-like light. The night wind whispers past. Where my simple wishes alight, a hidden dream reveals itself.

12010063.Name: Trickster's Gift
12010063.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010063.Description2: Carrying the ancient legacy of "riding it to the skies," this broom-shaped Mount Imagine balances you with sturdy footholds and a plush seat for comfort. Let the night wind be your companion as you soar beneath the moonlight!

12010064.Name: Wandering Blooms
12010064.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.

12010065.Name: Wandering Blooms - Dream
12010065.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.

12010066.Name: Winter Reindeer
12010066.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010066.Description2:
What? Is this a Caprahorn?... Something feels off. Shouldn't it be a different animal bringing gifts...?
"That must be your imagination! A little Caprahorn jingling in the snow—isn't that nice, too?"

12010067.Name: Turbo Bunny
12010067.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010067.Description2: It loves to dart around the schoolyard, writing its own wild chapter of youth.

12010068.Name: Rampaging Bunny
12010068.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010068.Description2: "The moment you hop on, you're gone! Wait for me next time—I can't keep up! "

12010069.Name: Polar Night Wanderer
12010069.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010069.Description2: The world slows its pace in the snow, revealing the true shape of the journey.

12010070.Name: Polar Night Wanderer - Starfrost
12010070.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010070.Description2: On a snowy night, a bird plucks a shooting star for you, and you make a wish for eternity.

12010071.Name: Wonderland Cruiser
12010071.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010071.Description2: Hop on! This furry bus has no map—it simply follows the scent of buttered bread, leading the way to riddles with no answers.

12010072.Name: Wonderland Cruiser - Wandering Star
12010072.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010072.Description2: Do you believe six impossible things can happen before breakfast? One is a purple cat—it's planning to take you out the window and into the galaxy to scoop up a handful of stars to eat.

12010073.Name: Moon-Chasing Dragon - Head
12010073.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010073.Description2:
Golden threads weave a traveler from beyond the clouds, fluttering down, straying into the mortal world. A shining pearl guides the way, linking spirit and divine. Like a dragon returning to the vast sea, like fire kindling through a thousand springs.
Unwilling to lie amid the ice and snow of the Ninth Heaven, it instead yearns for the warmth of the human world. Passing through flowers and circling trees, it lingers, drunk in the evening glow. One full moon stirs above, while countless falling sparks trace the marks of scattered stars.

12010074.Name: Moon-Chasing Dragon - Body
12010074.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010074.Description2:
Golden threads weave a traveler from beyond the clouds, fluttering down, straying into the mortal world. A shining pearl guides the way, linking spirit and divine. Like a dragon returning to the vast sea, like fire kindling through a thousand springs.
Unwilling to lie amid the ice and snow of the Ninth Heaven, it instead yearns for the warmth of the human world. Passing through flowers and circling trees, it lingers, drunk in the evening glow. One full moon stirs above, while countless falling sparks trace the marks of scattered stars.

12010075.Name: Moon-Chasing Dragon - Tail
12010075.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010075.Description2:
Golden threads weave a traveler from beyond the clouds, fluttering down, straying into the mortal world. A shining pearl guides the way, linking spirit and divine. Like a dragon returning to the vast sea, like fire kindling through a thousand springs.
Unwilling to lie amid the ice and snow of the Ninth Heaven, it instead yearns for the warmth of the human world. Passing through flowers and circling trees, it lingers, drunk in the evening glow. One full moon stirs above, while countless falling sparks trace the marks of scattered stars.

12010076.Name: Sun-Praying Lion - Head
12010076.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010076.Description2:
Rising from the slumber of the spring, a coat of golden sheen is shook loose. Clamor crowds the ears, wholly ignored—only the game upon the ball is craved.
Steps shatter the icy water before the stairs, startling crimson plum buds from the tips of the boughs. Head lifted toward the sun, the cry surges fierce, gathering a thousandfold auspicious grace.

12010077.Name: Sun-Praying Lion - Tail
12010077.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010077.Description2:
Rising from the slumber of the spring, a coat of golden sheen is shook loose. Clamor crowds the ears, wholly ignored—only the game upon the ball is craved.
Steps shatter the icy water before the stairs, startling crimson plum buds from the tips of the boughs. Head lifted toward the sun, the cry surges fierce, gathering a thousandfold auspicious grace.

12010078.Name: Flutter-Ear Duke
12010078.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010078.Description2: Bunny-shaped Mount Imagine. It is said to have gradually evolved through generations of effort. They not only perform well in snowy terrain but also become great companions for adventurers.

12010079.Name: Sonic Escape
12010079.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010079.Description2: Give speed a reason, and the horizon a beat.

12010080.Name: Sonic Escape - Reverb
12010080.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010080.Description2: Like the lingering echo after an entrance, like a final glance before departure—like a victorious escape that could have been swift and decisive, yet still leaves one unable to forget it.

12010081.Name: Astral Delivery
12010081.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010081.Description2: A fantastical vehicle from another realm, it hovers effortlessly by mystical forces and glides with astonishing grace.

12010082.Name: Aurora Pilgrimage
12010082.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.
12010082.Description2: Despite its small appearance, it can reliably support the rider and has impressive speed that contradicts its short legs. It is a round-eyed cutie.

12010083.Name: Eternal Night Kingdom
12010083.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.

12010084.Name: Eternal Night Kingdom - Thorn
12010084.Description: A Mount Imagine that increases Moving Speed and offers unique skills for a different experience.

13010012.Name: Homestead EXP
13010012.Description: Homestead EXP increases your Homestead Level.

14010001.Name: Spirit Echo - Happy
14010001.Description:
A "Fairy Tail" crossover Spirit Echo! Natsu's partner. Though he's a cat, he's an excellent mage who can fly using a magic called "Aera." He absolutely loves fish.
Can be viewed and summoned in Inventory - Spirit Echo.
Summon then tap the Echo to open the interaction wheel.

14010002.Name: Spirit Echo - Carla
14010002.Description:
A "Fairy Tail" crossover Spirit Echo! A cat of the Exceed race that can speak human language and use Aera magic. Occasionally displays precognitive abilities. Loves Darjeeling tea.
Can be viewed and summoned in Inventory - Spirit Echo.
Summon then tap the Echo to open the interaction wheel.
